events.current_state_en:
On Sept. 16, Dr. Lani Clinton — half-sister of the late Ondo Finance founder Nathan Allman — and Ondo investor David Chen petitioned a Hawaiian court for a limited conservatorship over their 77-year-old mother Kathleen Allman's share of the founder's estate, alleging cognitive impairment, alcoholism and reckless financial spending. Kathleen Allman denies the claims and accuses the petitioners of forum-shopping after failing to remove her from Ondo's board, arguing that Chen is funding the Hawaii petition, shares counsel with acting CEO Ian De Bode, and relied on sealed materials from the Delaware case.

The disputed estate includes a "controlling equity interest in Ondo Finance" plus a "very large holding of ONDO tokens," so the outcome of this family litigation determines who effectively controls one of the largest real-world-asset tokenization protocols and its governance token. The conservatorship fight also runs parallel to Kathleen Allman's suit accusing acting CEO Ian De Bode of a "brazen usurpation of corporate control" and of plotting an approximately $11 million compensation package within a week of the founder's death.

According to the litigation, De Bode's package comprised a $900,000 annual salary and bonus, a $1 million signing bonus, 26 million restricted token units valued at more than $9 million, and awards covering 846,000 shares that would have raised his stake from 0.33% to 8% — roughly a 24-fold increase — with vesting set to begin May 25, the day after Allman died. Kathleen Allman had appointed herself and her other child, Tahnee Towill, to Ondo's board and named herself chair and interim CEO, but De Bode remains acting CEO and a board member under a Sept. 3 court order, and a Delaware court has already rejected his argument that Kathy and Towill were unfit to serve as directors.
events.current_state_zh:
2026年9月16日，已故 Ondo Finance 创始人 Nathan Allman 同母异父的姐姐、杜克大学医学教授 Lani Clinton 与 Ondo 早期投资人 David Chen 向夏威夷法院提交申请，要求对77岁的 Kathleen Allman 所继承的创始人遗产份额设立有限监护（limited conservatorship），理由是其存在认知障碍、酗酒和不当财务支出。Kathleen Allman 否认上述指控，并指对方因未能将她逐出 Ondo 董事会而“挑选法院”（forum-shopping），称 Chen 为夏威夷申请提供资金、与代理 CEO Ian De Bode 共用律师，并引用了特拉华州案件中的密封材料。

争议遗产既包含“对 Ondo Finance 的控股性股权”，也包含“数量非常庞大的 ONDO 代币”，因此这场家族诉讼的结果实际上决定了这家头部现实世界资产（RWA）代币化协议及其治理代币由谁掌控。与此同时，Kathleen Allman 还起诉代理 CEO Ian De Bode “公然篡夺公司控制权”，并指控他在创始人去世一周内便谋划了一份约1100万美元的薪酬方案。

根据诉讼文件，De Bode 的薪酬方案包括90万美元年薪加奖金、100万美元签约奖金、价值逾900万美元的2600万枚受限代币单位，以及可将持股从0.33%提升至8%（约24倍）的84.6万股奖励，归属期自5月25日——即 Allman 去世次日——开始。Kathleen Allman 曾任命自己和另一个孩子 Tahnee Towill 进入 Ondo 董事会，并自任董事长兼临时 CEO，但根据9月3日的法院命令，De Bode 仍是代理 CEO 兼董事会成员；特拉华州法院也已驳回他关于 Kathy 与 Towill 不适合担任董事的主张。
events.title_en: Ondo succession crisis deepens as founder's half-sister seeks conservatorship
events.title_zh: Ondo Finance 继承权之争升级：创始人之妹申请有限监护

updates.background_en: Ondo Finance is a leading real-world-asset tokenization protocol that manages roughly $3 billion in tokenized assets, mainly U.S. Treasuries and money-market products from issuers such as Franklin Templeton and BlackRock, giving it around 30% of the tokenized Treasuries market; ONDO is its governance token. Founder Nathan Allman died suddenly in May at age 32 without a will, so a probate court named his parents, Kathleen and Lawrence Allman, as inheritors of an estate that includes his equity and token stake in the protocol. A limited conservatorship is a court arrangement in which a designated person is empowered to manage specific affairs or property of someone judged unable to do so — here applied to Kathleen Allman's inherited Ondo-related equity and tokens. Because there was no will, allocation and control of that stake can only be resolved through probate and multi-state litigation.
updates.background_zh: Ondo Finance 是将美国国债等传统资产代币化的头部 RWA 协议，管理约30亿美元资产，合作方包括 Franklin Templeton、BlackRock 等机构的产品，约占代币化国债市场30%的份额，ONDO 则是其治理代币。创始人 Nathan Allman 于今年5月突然去世，年仅32岁且未立遗嘱，遗嘱检验法院随后指定其父母 Kathleen 与 Lawrence Allman 为继承人，继承内容包括他在协议中的股权和代币份额。有限监护是一种司法安排，由法院指定他人代为管理被认定无法自行处理特定事务者的部分事务或财产，本案中申请的对象正是 Kathleen Allman 所继承的 Ondo 相关股权与代币。由于没有遗嘱，这部分权益的归属与控制只能通过遗嘱认证和跨州诉讼来解决。

events.current_state_en: Security researchers at Hacktron used Anthropic's Claude to chain an image-processing vulnerability with an OpenAI identity flaw, breaching employee ChatGPT and Codex accounts and reaching an internal OpenAI code repository within 72 hours.
events.current_state_zh:
Hacktron AI 的安全研究人员发布了一份技术报告，披露他们通过串联 libheif 中的一个堆缓冲区溢出漏洞与一处 SSO 配置错误，实现了远程代码执行，并在不到 72 小时内接触到 OpenAI 的内部代码仓库。报告还称，直到大约两个月前，任何登录 community.openai.com 的用户或 OpenAI 员工都可能遭遇 ChatGPT 与 Codex 账号被接管，并且在早先模型均失败的情况下，他们借助 Claude Opus 5 在约三小时内绕过了 ASLR。

这是一次罕见的公开演示：一个被广泛使用的图像解码库中的内存安全漏洞，加上身份层的配置错误，就足以串联成对一家人工智能实验室内部代码仓库的完整入侵，而这类资产正是知识产权高度集中的地方。它还显示出大模型辅助的自动化正在缩短从发现漏洞到写出可用利用程序的时间，从而提高了整个软件供应链在补丁管理与身份治理上的门槛。

该溢出漏洞编号为 CVE-2026-32741，影响 libheif 1.21.2 及更早版本：构造一个包含恶意 “mski” 蒙版图像的 HEIF 文件，即可在 MaskImageCodec::decode_mask_image() 中触发堆缓冲区溢出；相应的补丁主要针对图像叠加图层的边界检查。社区分析指出，HEIF 支持多图像合成、旋转、裁剪、Alpha 通道和缩略图等特性，使其攻击面远大于传统的 JPEG 解码器，而照片上传功能恰恰会引入这类代码路径。
events.title_en: A heap overflow and SSO misconfiguration to compromise OpenAI internal repos
events.title_zh: 研究人员利用 Claude 与漏洞链在72小时内入侵 OpenAI 内部代码库

updates.background_en: libheif is an open-source library that decodes and encodes HEIF/AVIF images, the container formats used by many phone cameras and browsers; a heap overflow in such a decoder can let an attacker overwrite memory and potentially execute code in the process that parses the file. ASLR (address space layout randomization) is an operating-system defense that randomizes memory addresses so an attacker cannot reliably jump to injected code, and bypassing it is typically the hardest step in turning a crash into reliable code execution. Single sign-on (SSO) systems such as SAML and OIDC let one identity provider grant access to many downstream services, so a misconfiguration there can produce tokens that look legitimate and silently unlock connected apps like GitHub, Slack or email. Community reporting notes that OpenAI's own help forum, community.openai.com, was the entry point for the account-takeover angle.
updates.background_zh: libheif 是一个开源的 HEIF/AVIF 图像编解码库，这类容器格式被许多手机相机与浏览器使用；解码器中的堆溢出可以让攻击者覆盖内存，并有可能在解析该文件的进程中执行代码。ASLR（地址空间布局随机化）是操作系统的一项防御机制，通过随机化内存地址让攻击者无法可靠地跳转到注入的代码，绕过它通常是把“崩溃”变成“可靠代码执行”过程中最难的一步。SAML、OIDC 等单点登录（SSO）体系让一个身份提供方为众多下游服务授予访问权限，因此其中的配置错误可能生成看似合法的令牌，静默解锁 GitHub、Slack 或邮箱等已接入的应用。社区讨论指出，OpenAI 自有的帮助论坛 community.openai.com 正是账号接管路径的入口。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters dug into the libheif patch itself, observing that the root cause was bounds checking for image overlays and arguing that HEIF's compositing, rotation and thumbnail features create a needlessly large attack surface for a forum that only needs photo uploads. Others highlighted the autonomous-agent angle, noting an LLM was placed in a "goal loop" against a Discourse instance disguised as a CTF target, and several expressed surprise that no Anthropic or OpenAI model weights have leaked despite repeated breaches.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论者深入分析了 libheif 的补丁本身，指出根因在于图像叠加图层的边界检查，并认为 HEIF 的合成、旋转与缩略图等特性，对一个只需要上传照片的论坛而言制造了毫无必要的大攻击面。还有人关注自主智能体这一角度，提到大模型被置于针对一个伪装成 CTF 目标的 Discourse 实例的“目标循环”中，也有不少人惊讶于尽管入侵事件屡有发生，Anthropic 或 OpenAI 的模型权重至今没有一次泄露。

updates.current_state_zh:
Hacktron AI 的安全研究人员发布了一份技术报告，披露他们通过串联 libheif 中的一个堆缓冲区溢出漏洞与一处 SSO 配置错误，实现了远程代码执行，并在不到 72 小时内接触到 OpenAI 的内部代码仓库。报告还称，直到大约两个月前，任何登录 community.openai.com 的用户或 OpenAI 员工都可能遭遇 ChatGPT 与 Codex 账号被接管，并且在早先模型均失败的情况下，他们借助 Claude Opus 5 在约三小时内绕过了 ASLR。

这是一次罕见的公开演示：一个被广泛使用的图像解码库中的内存安全漏洞，加上身份层的配置错误，就足以串联成对一家人工智能实验室内部代码仓库的完整入侵，而这类资产正是知识产权高度集中的地方。它还显示出大模型辅助的自动化正在缩短从发现漏洞到写出可用利用程序的时间，从而提高了整个软件供应链在补丁管理与身份治理上的门槛。

该溢出漏洞编号为 CVE-2026-32741，影响 libheif 1.21.2 及更早版本：构造一个包含恶意 “mski” 蒙版图像的 HEIF 文件，即可在 MaskImageCodec::decode_mask_image() 中触发堆缓冲区溢出；相应的补丁主要针对图像叠加图层的边界检查。社区分析指出，HEIF 支持多图像合成、旋转、裁剪、Alpha 通道和缩略图等特性，使其攻击面远大于传统的 JPEG 解码器，而照片上传功能恰恰会引入这类代码路径。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Researchers chained a libheif heap overflow with an SSO misconfiguration to gain remote code execution and access OpenAI's internal repositories within 72 hours.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Researchers chained a libheif heap overflow with an SSO misconfiguration to gain remote code execution and access OpenAI's internal repositories within 72 hours.
updates.market_impact_en: There is no direct exposure of crypto assets here; the plausible transmission is sentiment, as a high-profile breach at a leading AI lab reinforces a security-risk narrative that can weigh on the AI- and agent-themed token segment and on general risk appetite in digital-asset markets. Any effect would be indirect and unverifiable in real time, flowing through narrative and positioning rather than through liquidity, custody or supply mechanics.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此事对加密资产没有直接敞口，可能的传导路径是市场情绪：一家头部人工智能实验室被高调攻破，会强化“AI 安全风险”这一叙事，从而对 AI 与智能体主题的代币板块以及数字资产市场的整体风险偏好形成压力。其影响是间接的，且难以及时验证，主要通过叙事与仓位传导，而非流动性、托管或供给机制。

events.current_state_en: Ethereum developers confirmed Glamsterdam testnet dates and warned attackers could exploit free test ether and disposable builder identities to disrupt Sepolia block auctions by withholding transaction payloads; the Ethereum Foundation further announced the upgrade will activate on the Sepolia testnet on October 6, 2026, requiring node operators to update clients, with Hoodi and mainnet dates undecided.

events.current_state_en: Zcash plans to activate NU7 on Nov. 5, cutting block times to 25 seconds while keeping daily issuance unchanged; the upgrade will also disable version 4 transactions, potentially making ZEC in the legacy Sprout shielded pool unspendable; testnet is scheduled for Oct. 6 and a mainnet activation decision is expected on Oct. 20.

updates.background_en: Aave is a decentralized, non-custodial liquidity protocol where users supply assets to earn interest or borrow against collateral, and its governance token is AAVE. Tokenized securities — such as stocks, bonds or fund interests represented as a crypto asset on a blockchain — have become a growing part of onchain markets. USDC is a fully reserved stablecoin issued by Circle that is designed to maintain a value equivalent to the US dollar.
updates.background_zh: Aave 是一个去中心化、非托管的流动性协议，用户可存入资产赚取利息，或以抵押品借入资产，其治理代币为 AAVE。代币化证券——即以区块链上的加密资产形式表示的股票、债券或基金权益——在链上市场中的占比不断上升。USDC 是由 Circle 发行的全额储备稳定币，设计目标是维持与美元等值。
updates.current_state_en: Aave V4 on Base now accepts Coinbase-issued tokenized stocks — including Apple, Nvidia and Tesla — as collateral for USDC loans for non-U.S. users.
updates.current_state_zh:
代币化的苹果与英伟达股票现可作为抵押品，在 Aave 借贷协议上借入 USDC。此举将现实世界资产（RWA）抵押品引入 DeFi 信贷市场，在 Aave 上形成了以股票为抵押的借贷产品。

此举使一家主流 DeFi 借贷协议接受的抵押品范围从加密原生资产扩展到代币化股票，首次以这种形式将股票敞口与链上信贷连接起来。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Aave V4 on Base now accepts Coinbase-issued tokenized stocks — including Apple, Nvidia and Tesla — as collateral for USDC loans for non-U.S. users.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Aave V4 on Base now accepts Coinbase-issued tokenized stocks — including Apple, Nvidia and Tesla — as collateral for USDC loans for non-U.S. users.
updates.market_impact_en: The change affects Aave's lending markets directly, adding tokenized equity exposure to the collateral set that supports USDC borrowing, and it touches the wider RWA and tokenized-equity segment through collateral eligibility and onchain credit channels. Any effect on AAVE governance token sentiment or on USDC borrowing demand depends on how much of these tokenized stocks is actually supplied as collateral.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一变化直接影响 Aave 的借贷市场：在支撑 USDC 借款的抵押品集合中新增了代币化股票敞口，并通过抵押品资格与链上信贷渠道，牵动更广泛的 RWA 与代币化股票板块。对 AAVE 治理代币情绪或 USDC 借款需求的实际影响，取决于这些代币化股票真正被用作抵押品的规模。

updates.background_en: Aave is one of the largest DeFi lending protocols, and its V4 deployment has drawn deposits quickly since launch: deposits sat below $340 million at the start of August and climbed to roughly $577 million by early September before surpassing $1 billion. Base is a Coinbase-built Ethereum layer-2 that uses the OP Stack and settles on Ethereum. Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based digital assets designed to represent economic exposure to traditional shares.
updates.background_zh: Aave 是规模最大的 DeFi 借贷协议之一，其 V4 版本自上线以来存款增长迅速：8 月初存款不足 3.4 亿美元，到 9 月初升至约 5.77 亿美元，随后突破 10 亿美元。Base 是由 Coinbase 构建的以太坊二层网络，采用 OP Stack，并结算于以太坊主网。代币化股票是旨在代表传统股票经济敞口的区块链数字资产。
updates.current_state_en: Aave V4 on Base accepts seven Coinbase stock tokens as collateral for USDC loans, with a 21 million USDC borrowing cap and access limited to eligible non-US investors.
updates.current_state_zh: Aave V4 在 Base 上接受七种 Coinbase 股票代币作为 USDC 贷款的抵押品，借款上限为 2100 万 USDC，且仅限符合条件的非美国投资者。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Aave has enabled seven Coinbase-issued stock tokens as collateral for USDC loans in a dedicated V4 market on Base, with a 21 million USDC borrowing cap and access restricted to eligible non-US investors.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Aave has enabled seven Coinbase-issued stock tokens as collateral for USDC loans in a dedicated V4 market on Base, with a 21 million USDC borrowing cap and access restricted to eligible non-US investors.
updates.market_impact_en: The change creates a direct channel between Coinbase's tokenized-equity product and DeFi credit on Base: tokenized stock collateral can support new USDC borrowing demand and shift utilization in Aave V4's Base market, while also tying that market's risk profile to equity price moves. Because borrowing is capped at 21 million USDC and limited to non-US investors, the immediate footprint on DeFi liquidity is bounded.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这一变化在 Coinbase 的代币化股票产品与 Base 上的 DeFi 信贷之间建立了直接通道：代币化股票抵押品可支撑新的 USDC 借款需求，并改变 Aave V4 的 Base 市场中的资金利用率，同时也使该市场的风险状况与股票价格波动挂钩。由于借款上限为 2100 万 USDC 且仅限非美国投资者，其对 DeFi 流动性的即时影响范围有限。

events.current_state_en: Hyperliquid launched native manual borrowing on HyperCore, allowing users to pledge HYPE or Bitcoin as collateral to borrow USDC or USDT, with $269 million borrowed on the first day as HYPE reached a new all-time high above $90.
events.current_state_zh:
9 月 18 日，Hyperliquid 推出原生手动借贷功能，用户可质押 HYPE 或比特币作为抵押品，直接通过 HyperCore 借入 USDC 或 USDT。上线首日借贷规模约 2.69 亿美元；同期 HYPE 一周内上涨约 15%，盘中最高触及约 91.06 美元，超过此前约 89.60 美元的纪录。

此次上线让 Hyperliquid 从衍生品与现货交易所扩展至信贷、抵押与收益生成领域，用户无需离开平台即可在交易与借贷之间切换。首日即达 2.69 亿美元的规模，说明该借贷原语有望成为该生态内重要的稳定币流动性来源与 HYPE 需求来源，而非孤立的附属产品。

HYPE 的贷款价值比（LTV）为 65%，比特币为 50%，对应的清算阈值分别为 82.5% 与 75%。由于同一批资金池此前已支持组合保证金业务，借款方可动用超过 4 亿美元的既有流动性；稳定币供给方按资金利用率获得浮动利息，组合保证金用户还能就闲置稳定币余额赚取收益。
events.title_en: Hyperliquid opens native lending as HYPE hits new ATH above $90
events.title_zh: Hyperliquid 在 HyperCore 上线原生借贷，HYPE 突破 90 美元创新高

updates.background_en: HyperCore is the order-book and margin layer of the Hyperliquid blockchain where perpetuals, spot markets and portfolio margin are settled, while HyperEVM handles general smart contracts. Lending protocols typically let users deposit crypto as collateral and borrow stablecoins against it, with the LTV ratio determining how much can be borrowed and the liquidation threshold marking when the position can be closed. USDC and USDT are dollar-pegged stablecoins issued by Circle and Tether respectively, and they are the dominant units of account for on-chain credit. Hyperliquid's founder, Jeff Yan, compared separating the lending primitive from derivatives margin to Amazon spinning out AWS so one underlying system can serve multiple products.
updates.background_zh: HyperCore 是 Hyperliquid 区块链的订单簿与保证金层，永续合约、现货市场与组合保证金均在此结算，而通用智能合约则由 HyperEVM 承载。借贷协议通常允许用户存入加密货币作为抵押品并借出稳定币，LTV 比率决定可借额度，清算阈值则标志仓位可被强制平仓的时点。USDC 与 USDT 分别由 Circle 和 Tether 发行、锚定美元，是链上信贷最主要的记账单位。Hyperliquid 创始人 Jeff Yan 将借贷原语与衍生品保证金分离的做法，类比为亚马逊拆分出 AWS，使同一底层系统能够服务多种产品。

updates.market_impact_en: The new market adds a direct collateral channel for HYPE and Bitcoin on HyperCore while deepening the stablecoin pools that already support portfolio margin, so lending utilization now influences funding and borrow demand for HYPE and the network's roughly $6.77 billion USDC supply. Kraken parent Payward's plan to offer on-chain perpetual futures to US clients via Hyperliquid's HIP-3 framework adds a parallel regulatory and distribution channel into the same ecosystem.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该新市场在 HyperCore 上为 HYPE 与比特币新增了直接的抵押渠道，同时加深了本就支撑组合保证金的稳定币池，因此借贷利用率如今会影响 HYPE 的资金与借款需求，以及该网络约 67.7 亿美元的 USDC 存量。Kraken 母公司 Payward 计划通过 Hyperliquid 的 HIP-3 框架为美国客户提供链上永续合约，为同一生态开辟了并行的监管与分销通道。

events.current_state_en: Bitcoin jumped 5.88% to $80,846 after the Fed's rate hike was paired with a dovish dot plot, triggering over $445 million in crypto liquidations including $230 million in Bitcoin shorts.
events.current_state_zh:
比特币在24小时内上涨5.88%至80,846美元，开盘报76,355美元，盘中最高触及80,857美元。此前美联储加息25个基点，但其点阵图显示到2027年底政策利率中值仅为4.1%。这轮上涨清算了超过4.45亿美元的加密空头头寸，其中比特币空头就超过2.3亿美元。

这一事件表明加密衍生品如今对美联储政策信号的反应极为直接：仅凭一份偏鸽的预测便引发了连锁空头挤压，抹平了此前Clarity Act在参议院表决失败后引发的恐慌性抛售。这说明推动比特币单日大幅波动的不仅是现货需求，杠杆头寸同样关键，而比特币目前仍较此前历史高点低近20%。

技术指标支持这轮涨势，但也提示涨速过快：ADX为40.6，远高于25的趋势确认门槛，且DI+高于DI-；50日EMA已上穿200日EMA，自上周六起形成黄金交叉。RSI为63.3，处于看涨区间但正快速逼近70的超买警戒线；挤压动能指标已连续11根K线保持开启，8.06%的收缩读数显示波动率仍被压缩，更大级别的释放可能还在后面。
events.title_en: Bitcoin Blasts Past $80K and a Fresh Short Squeeze Is On
events.title_zh: 比特币突破8万美元，美联储鸽派点阵图引爆4.45亿美元空头挤压

updates.background_en: The Fed's dot plot is a quarterly chart in which each FOMC official marks their projected path for the federal funds rate; lower dots indicate a more dovish, less aggressive tightening outlook, which typically lifts risk assets. A short position bets an asset's price will fall, and traders open shorts using leverage and collateral; if price rises sharply, their collateral is liquidated through forced buying, which pushes prices higher still and triggers cascading liquidations known as a short squeeze. In crypto this effect is amplified because most volume trades on perpetual futures with high leverage. The Clarity Act, a US market-structure bill intended to give crypto firms a durable statutory framework, failed a Senate procedural vote earlier in the week, sending Bitcoin below $75,000 before the Fed-driven rebound.
updates.background_zh: 美联储点阵图是一张季度更新的图表，每位FOMC成员在其中标出自己对联邦基金利率路径的预测；点位越低代表政策立场越鸽派、紧缩力度越小，通常利好风险资产。空头头寸押注资产价格下跌，交易者通常以保证金加杠杆开空；若价格快速上涨，其保证金被强制买入平仓，反而进一步推高价格，形成连锁清算，即所谓“空头挤压”。在加密市场，由于大部分成交量集中在高杠杆永续合约上，这一效应会被放大。Clarity Act是一项旨在为加密企业提供长期法定监管框架的美国市场结构法案，本周早些时候未通过参议院程序性投票，比特币因此一度跌破75,000美元，随后才因美联储决议反弹。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Bitcoin jumped 5.88% to $80,846 after the Fed's rate hike was paired with a dovish dot plot, triggering over $445 million in crypto liquidations including $230 million in Bitcoin shorts.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bitcoin jumped 5.88% to $80,846 after the Fed's rate hike was paired with a dovish dot plot, triggering over $445 million in crypto liquidations including $230 million in Bitcoin shorts.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission ran through derivatives: a dovish Fed repricing forced buy-backs of leveraged shorts, and the roughly $445 million in liquidations (over half of it Bitcoin) fed the spot move higher across major venues. Exposure is concentrated in perpetual futures and margin markets for Bitcoin and other large-cap tokens, where funding rates and open interest now reflect a rebuilt long bias, leaving them sensitive to any shift in rate expectations or reversal in macro sentiment.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道主要在衍生品端：美联储立场转鸽促使空头被迫回补，约4.45亿美元的清算（其中过半为比特币）进一步推动各大交易平台的现货价格上行。风险敞口集中在比特币及其他大市值代币的永续合约与保证金市场，资金费率与未平仓合约目前反映出多头仓位重新累积，使其对利率预期变化或宏观情绪反转更为敏感。

events.current_state_en: Researchers demonstrate a photon-emission-guided laser fault injection attack that bypasses the RP2350 microcontroller's secure debug protections, requiring physical access and roughly $250,000 in laboratory equipment.
events.current_state_zh:
Ledger Donjon 的研究人员展示了一种以光子发射（photon emission）为引导的激光故障注入（LFI）攻击，成功在被锁定安全调试的 RP2350-A4 微控制器上重新启用调试接口，从而能够暂停处于 Secure 状态的内核并提取受保护的机密数据。该成果发表在 Ledger Donjon 官方博客上，是首个公开记录的针对该芯片安全调试逻辑的光学故障攻击。

Raspberry Pi 将 RP2350 宣传为一款适用于安全敏感场景的微控制器，其安全隔离区（secure enclave）也让它成为 YubiKey 等专用安全芯片之外更廉价的选择。此次安全调试被成功绕过，削弱了在该芯片上构建密钥存储或硬件钱包者的信任假设，也加剧了安全硬件设计者与物理攻击者之间持续不断的攻防军备竞赛。

该攻击使用波长为 980 纳米、最大光功率 2.97 瓦的脉冲激光器，实际运行在约 40% 功率（约 1.2 瓦），脉冲宽度为 100 纳秒，并通过 50 倍物镜聚焦；在注入故障前，他们先用光子发射显微镜定位确切的攻击目标电路。攻击需要物理接触、对芯片封装进行破坏性处理，并配备价值约 25 万美元的实验室设备，不过有评论者认为在家庭实验室中复现的成本可低于 2.5 万美元。
events.title_en: Photon-Emission-Guided Laser Fault Injection Enables RP2350 Secure Debug
events.title_zh: 光子发射引导激光攻击攻破 RP2350 安全调试保护

updates.background_en: Photon emission microscopy (PEM) detects the faint infrared light that transistors emit when they switch, letting researchers map which parts of a chip are active; laser fault injection (LFI) then fires a focused laser pulse at those spots to flip bits or corrupt logic at a chosen moment. The RP2350 is Raspberry Pi's dual Arm Cortex-M33 microcontroller, and its "secure debug" mode is a controlled channel that allows a debugger to access secure memory-mapped resources and inspect a core running in the Secure state — normally locked out unless the correct key is supplied. Raspberry Pi's own response post acknowledged that the Donjon team showed the debug interface could be re-enabled with a lab full of specialised equipment, something the company had been trying to make impossible.
updates.background_zh: 光子发射显微镜（PEM）可以探测晶体管开关时发出的微弱红外光，帮助研究者绘制出芯片上哪些区域正在工作；激光故障注入（LFI）则在这些位置发射聚焦激光脉冲，在特定时刻翻转比特或破坏逻辑。RP2350 是 Raspberry Pi 推出的双核 Arm Cortex-M33 微控制器，其“安全调试”模式是一条受控通道，允许调试器访问安全内存映射资源并检查运行于 Secure 状态的内核，正常情况下必须提供正确密钥才能解锁。Raspberry Pi 官方也发文回应，承认 Donjon 团队证明只要拥有成套专业显微镜与激光设备，就能重新启用该调试接口，而这正是公司此前试图使其无法做到的事情。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters broadly praised the level of technical detail while pushing back on the $250,000 price tag, noting that similar attacks have been replicated at home for under $25,000 — one cited replacing a $5,000 ChipShouter with a $50 PicoEMP when reproducing a prior MPC5566 attack. Others framed the RP2350's secure enclave as a Yubikey alternative and described the result as part of an inevitable arms race between safe-crackers and safe-builders, while some simply noted the attack is "not super practical, but neat".
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论者普遍赞赏该研究的技术细节，但对 25 万美元的设备成本提出异议，指出类似攻击在家庭实验室中花费不到 2.5 万美元即可复现——有人提到在复现此前的 MPC5566 攻击时，用 50 美元的 PicoEMP 替代了 5000 美元的 ChipShouter。也有人把 RP2350 的安全隔离区视为 YubiKey 的替代方案，并将这一成果描述为“开锁者与造锁者”之间不可避免的军备竞赛的一部分，还有评论直言该攻击“不太实用，但很漂亮”。
updates.current_state_en: Researchers demonstrate a photon-emission-guided laser fault injection attack that bypasses the RP2350 microcontroller's secure debug protections, requiring physical access and roughly $250,000 in laboratory equipment.

updates.market_impact_en: The most direct transmission channel is sentiment and trust around hardware-wallet supply chains: any wallet or key-storage product relying on the RP2350's secure enclave now carries a publicly documented physical-extraction path, which may shift vendor evaluations toward dedicated secure elements. Because exploitation demands physical possession, destructive sample preparation, and roughly $250,000 in lab gear, the near-term exposure for users of existing devices remains tied to targeted, in-person attack scenarios rather than remote or large-scale risk.
updates.market_impact_zh: 最直接的传导渠道是围绕硬件钱包供应链的情绪与信任：任何依赖 RP2350 安全隔离区的钱包或密钥存储产品，如今都面对一条已被公开记录的物理提取路径，这可能促使厂商在选型时更倾向专用安全元件。由于利用该攻击需要实际持有设备、对样品进行破坏性处理并配备约 25 万美元的实验室设备，现有设备用户的近期风险仍局限于定向的、需要接触实物的攻击场景，而非远程或大规模风险。

events.current_state_en: S&P Global is acquiring OpenZeppelin, the widely used smart-contract security and development tooling firm, in a notable TradFi consolidation of crypto infrastructure.
events.current_state_zh:
9月17日，标普全球宣布达成协议收购智能合约安全与开发工具公司OpenZeppelin，交易财务条款未披露，且仍需满足交割条件。收购完成后，OpenZeppelin将保留其名称、由首席执行官Demian Brener领导的团队以及开源代码，作为独立业务部门运营，并向标普全球评级总裁Yann Le Pallec汇报。

OpenZeppelin Contracts是行业内使用最广泛的智能合约库，因此由一家大型金融数据与评级集团将其收入囊中，是传统金融不再局限于交易和托管、而是直接买入加密核心基础设施的最明显案例之一。这也让标普直接切入稳定币与代币化资产底层的安全层，此前标普还领投了加密数据服务商Kaiko，正在加速拓展数字资产业务。

OpenZeppelin表示，自2015年以来，通过其Contracts软件转移的价值已超过37万亿美元；当前代码库采用宽松的MIT许可证，公司声明已发布的版本将永久保持开源且不可撤回。此次公告对审计、工程工作、生态项目及开源代码作出了延续性承诺，但其现有服务条款仍允许对付费或托管方案进行调整，包括定价、功能、配额与使用限制，具体保护措施和通知方式视变更类型而定。

updates.background_en: OpenZeppelin is best known for OpenZeppelin Contracts, a library of reusable, audited Solidity components that developers import when building tokens, access-control systems and other on-chain logic; because deployed smart contracts are typically immutable, a vulnerability in that code can lead to irreversible losses, which is why the library is treated as a de facto security standard. The firm also runs a security-audit business, having completed more than 900 audits since 2017 across languages such as Solidity, Rust and Cairo. S&P Global is the parent of S&P Global Ratings, the largest of the "Big Three" credit-rating agencies alongside Moody's and Fitch, and its core business is financial information, benchmarks and analytics. The acquisition fits a broader pattern of traditional finance firms buying crypto infrastructure as markets move toward tokenization and 24/7 trading.
updates.background_zh: OpenZeppelin最著名的是OpenZeppelin Contracts——一套经过审计、可复用的Solidity组件库，开发者在构建代币、权限控制系统及其他链上逻辑时会直接引入；由于已部署的智能合约通常不可更改，代码中的漏洞可能造成不可逆的损失，因此该库被视为事实上的安全标准。公司同时经营安全审计业务，自2017年以来已完成900多次审计，覆盖Solidity、Rust、Cairo等语言。标普全球是标普全球评级的母公司，后者与穆迪、惠誉并称三大信用评级机构，标普全球的核心业务是金融信息、基准指数与分析服务。这笔收购契合了传统金融机构在市场走向代币化和7×24小时交易之际买入加密基础设施的整体趋势。

It also reinforces the tokenization and real-world-asset narrative that S&P is positioning around, which tends to affect sentiment toward infrastructure and RWA-related assets more than any single token.

events.current_state_en: A hack targeting crypto trading infrastructure provider Haruko compromised 15 clients, resulting in the theft of exchange API credentials, trading data, and funds.
events.current_state_zh:
总部位于英国、为机构提供加密货币投资组合管理与交易捕获技术的 Haruko 本周遭到网络攻击，共有 15 家客户受影响，其只读交易平台 API 凭证和交易数据被泄露。此外还有少量客户资金被盗，据报道部分规模较小的对冲基金客户出现资产损失。

这一事件表明，单一中间层软件供应商可能成为数十家机构交易台的系统性入口，因为被泄露的 API 凭证和交易数据会给受影响基金及其交易对手带来后续风险。它可能会促使机构加密交易领域加快对第三方供应商安全与凭证管理的审查，而该领域近期随着现货 ETF 和主经纪商业务的发展而迅速扩张。

据 CoinDesk 报道，被泄露的交易平台 API 信息属于只读权限，通常只允许攻击者查看余额与交易历史，而无法发起转账或下单，但报道仍提到有少量客户资金被盗。Haruko 的平台与数百家交易场所建立了全托管的集成连接，因此这一层级的凭证泄露可能同时波及大量交易所账户。
events.title_en: Haruko hack hits 15 crypto clients, with exchange API details, trading data and funds stolen - CoinDesk
events.title_zh: Haruko 遭网络攻击，15 家加密客户的 API 密钥与交易数据泄露

updates.background_en: Haruko was founded in 2019 and is headquartered in the United Kingdom, offering institutional clients portfolio management, trade capture and connectivity that sits between a fund's own systems and the many crypto exchanges it trades on. Exchange API keys are credentials that let software read account data or place trades on a user's behalf, which is why they are a high-value target: read-only keys limit what an attacker can do, while trading-enabled keys can move funds. Because funds rarely connect to exchanges manually, this kind of vendor layer is a common and often under-examined point of failure in crypto market infrastructure.
updates.background_zh: Haruko 成立于 2019 年，总部位于英国，为机构客户提供投资组合管理、交易捕获以及连接服务，处于基金自有系统与其所交易的众多加密货币交易所之间。交易所 API 密钥是允许软件代表用户读取账户数据或下单的凭证，因此成为高价值攻击目标：只读密钥会限制攻击者的操作范围，而具备交易权限的密钥则可能直接转移资金。由于基金很少手动连接交易所，这类供应商层级是加密市场基础设施中常见且往往被忽视的失效点。

据 CoinDesk 报道，被泄露的交易平台 API 信息属于只读权限，通常只允许攻击者查看余额与交易历史，而无法发起转账或下单，但报道仍提到有少量客户资金被盗。Haruko 的平台与数百家交易场所建立了全托管的集成连接，因此这一层级的凭证泄露可能同时波及大量交易所账户。

events.current_state_en: Neutrl opened NUSD redemptions at 51 cents while Strata's junior tranche (jrNUSD) was written to zero and senior tranche withdrawals settle in sNUSD at revised share values.
events.current_state_zh:
Neutrl 已按约 0.51 美元兑 1 美元的价格开放 NUSD 赎回；与此同时，Strata 安排了为期 48 小时的估值更新，将其次级份额代币 jrNUSD 的估值直接归零，并以调整后的份额价值用 sNUSD 结算优先级份额的提现。Strata 的披露文件称，问题并非智能合约漏洞利用、黑客攻击或代码缺陷。

对于这一结构化 DeFi 产品的存款人而言，这是一次实质性亏损事件，说明当损失规模较大时，作为首损缓冲的次级份额并不足以保护优先级资金。它凸显了一个风险：把分层结构叠加在单一收益策略之上，可能让损失直接传导给持有类稳定币代币的普通存款人。

Strata 的 srNUSD 与 jrNUSD 份额均暴露于策略合约所持有的 sNUSD；按照 Strata 的损失分摊规则，jrNUSD 在 srNUSD 之前承受损失。在 0.51 美元 NUSD 参考价值下，损失已超过次级份额的保护额度，这正是优先级持有人也以缩水价值结算的原因。jrNUSD 与 srNUSD 均为无需许可的代币，可在 DEX 上交易，用户在赎回后还需手动领取 NUSD/sNUSD。

In the Neutrl NUSD market, depositors mint srNUSD or jrNUSD, and the strategy contract holds sNUSD, the yield-bearing form of the underlying position.

events.current_state_en: A three-year-old Radix Engine bug, introduced in a 2023 code refactor and missed by an external audit, enabled a roughly $1.3 million vault drain and forced validators to halt the Radix blockchain for 10 days.
events.current_state_zh:
Radix 基金会于 9 月 17 日披露，2023 年 6 月对 Radix Engine（负责执行交易并强制执行资产所有权的软件层）的一次重构引入了一个漏洞，该漏洞于 8 月 31 日被利用，攻击者通过 26 笔交易盗走约 126 万美元的跨链资产。随后验证者主动将足够多的质押下线，使共识停止运行超过 10 天；在协议修复加入校验、阻止受限金库引用被用于普通提款后，用户交易于 9 月 11 日恢复。

这是一起实质性的协议级安全失败：该缺陷在执行层潜伏了三年多，还躲过了 Zellic 在 2024 年进行的外部审计，并且调查人员认为它可以被用于攻击网络上的任何金库，这意味着 130 万美元的损失低估了真实风险敞口。它还凸显了一次常规维护性改动如何制造系统性风险，并迫使网络牺牲活性——这一决定本身也会给用户和应用带来代价。

攻击者取走了约 458,915 USDC、72,420 USDT、61.08 ETH、6.35 wrapped Bitcoin、536.16 SOL 和 32.91 BNB，并通过 Hyperlane 将这些资产转移到以太坊、BNB Chain 和 Solana 后换成 ETH；没有私钥被泄露，Hyperlane 本身按设计正常运行。该漏洞改变了引擎处理金库引用的方式，使一笔交易能够指向他人的金库并调用普通提款函数，而未强制执行所有权边界；此外，池子价格被扭曲后，另一个账户从受影响池中提取了数百万 XRD，造成二次损失。

updates.background_en: Radix is a layer-1 network whose Radix Engine executes transactions and enforces asset ownership, with vaults acting as the on-chain containers that hold tokens for users, applications and liquidity pools. Because the engine is the shared execution layer for everything built on Radix, a flaw there affects all applications at once rather than a single contract. A blockchain halt occurs when validators can no longer reach consensus on new blocks — here it was a deliberate safety pause rather than a crash, and it freezes transfers, bridges and contract activity network-wide until a fix is deployed.

updates.detailed_summary_zh: A three-year-old Radix Engine bug, introduced in a 2023 code refactor and missed by an external audit, enabled a roughly $1.3 million vault drain and forced validators to halt the Radix blockchain for 10 days.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs mainly through Radix's own on-chain liquidity and sentiment: bridged stablecoin and blue-chip holdings were removed from one side of trading pairs, distorting pool prices so a separate account could extract millions of XRD, while the 10-day halt froze transfers and bridge activity for RDX holders and applications on the network. 攻击者取走了约 458,915 USDC、72,420 USDT、61.08 ETH、6.35 wrapped Bitcoin、536.16 SOL 和 32.91 BNB，并通过 Hyperlane 将这些资产转移到以太坊、BNB Chain 和 Solana 后换成 ETH；没有私钥被泄露，Hyperlane 本身按设计正常运行。该漏洞改变了引擎处理金库引用的方式，使一笔交易能够指向他人的金库并调用普通提款函数，而未强制执行所有权边界；此外，池子价格被扭曲后，另一个账户从受影响池中提取了数百万 XRD，造成二次损失。

events.current_state_en: Binance is launching 24/7 foreign exchange perpetual futures, starting with a USDBRL/USDT contract on Sept. 21 that uses a weighted index during FX hours and an orderbook-based EWMA pricing mechanism on weekends and holidays, with up to 100x leverage.
events.current_state_zh:
币安宣布推出7×24小时外汇永续合约，首个产品为USDBRLUSDT合约，将于9月21日上线，以USDT结算并提供最高100倍杠杆。该合约采用双模式定价：在正常外汇交易时段跟踪第三方数据供应商提供的加权指数，在周末及公共假日则改用基于订单簿的指数加权移动平均（EWMA）定价。

此举使全球最大加密货币交易所切入外汇这一按成交额计算全球最大的金融市场——国际清算银行数据显示，2025年4月全球场外外汇日均成交额约为9.6万亿美元。此前Bybit和Kraken已推出类似的7×24小时外汇永续产品，说明加密衍生品平台正竞相争夺传统外汇市场无法覆盖的汇率敞口与盘外价格发现需求。

周末定价刻意不依赖外部价格源，而是通过EWMA从币安自身订单簿推导价格，这一设计此前已用于币安基于大宗商品的TradFi永续合约，意味着盘外时段的保证金要求与强平价位可能由更薄的内部流动性而非参考汇率决定。根据币安合约公告，该合约以USDT结算，最小变动价位为0.0001，最小名义价值为5 USDT。

updates.background_en: Perpetual futures are derivative contracts with no expiry date; they stay anchored to spot prices through a periodic funding rate that longs or shorts pay each other, typically every eight hours on major platforms. Traditional spot FX is an over-the-counter, dealer-intermediated market that closes from Friday evening to Sunday, so there is no continuous exchange-traded pricing over the weekend. Crypto exchanges have begun wrapping FX exposure into USDT-settled perpetuals, letting crypto traders take currency positions without holding or settling the underlying currencies.
updates.background_zh: 永续合约是没有到期日的衍生品，通过多空双方定期互相支付的资金费率与现货价格保持锚定，主流平台通常每八小时结算一次。传统即期外汇是场外、由做市商撮合的市场，从周五晚间至周日休市，因此周末没有连续的交易场所报价。加密交易所开始将外汇敞口打包为USDT结算的永续合约，使加密交易者无需持有或交割标的货币即可建立汇率头寸。

updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel is market structure and liquidity: USDT-settled FX perpetuals deepen the use of stablecoins as margin collateral and route traditional currency flow into crypto orderbooks, while concentrating weekend USDBRL price discovery on Binance's own book. Thin off-hours liquidity on that book can amplify funding-rate swings and liquidation cascades for leveraged positions, and rising FX derivatives volume on crypto venues may also feed back into stablecoin demand and exchange fee revenue.
updates.market_impact_zh: 其传导渠道是市场结构与流动性：以USDT结算的外汇永续合约强化了稳定币作为保证金抵押品的用途，并把传统货币流动引入加密订单簿，同时将周末的USDBRL价格发现集中于币安自身的盘口。盘外流动性稀薄可能放大资金费率波动与杠杆仓位的连锁强平，而加密平台外汇衍生品成交量的上升也可能反过来影响稳定币需求与交易所手续费收入。

events.current_state_en: Coinbase is being sued for allegedly and unreasonably locking customers out of their accounts, raising concerns about user access to funds on the platform.
events.current_state_zh:
据 CoinMarketCap 报道，Coinbase 遭到起诉，被指“不当且不合理地”将客户锁定在账户之外。诉讼的核心是用户无法访问其存放在平台上的资金，而非发生黑客攻击或客户资产损失。

由于托管型交易所对客户账户拥有法律上的控制权并可以单方面限制访问，这起针对账户锁定的诉讼实际上是在检验中心化平台对用户资金拥有多大自由裁量权。案件发生在美国对交易所实务审查不断加码的背景下，其结果可能影响其他平台如何设计并公示账户冻结与申诉流程。

在 Coinbase 等大型交易所，账户锁定通常由自动化风控与合规系统触发，例如异常登录行为、身份验证（KYC）审核、反洗钱检查或制裁名单筛查，争议往往集中在这些审核解除的速度和透明度上。本案的诉求针对的是锁定行为本身是否合理，将其界定为资金访问问题，而非安全保护功能。
events.title_en: Coinbase Sued for 'Improperly and Unreasonably' Locking Customers Out of Accounts - CoinMarketCap
events.title_zh: Coinbase 因涉嫌不当锁定用户账户被起诉，托管账户访问权成焦点

updates.background_en: Custodial exchanges such as Coinbase hold customer assets on their behalf and operate under anti-money-laundering and know-your-customer obligations, which require monitoring accounts and, in some cases, restricting them. Account lockouts are a standard risk-control tool meant to protect users and satisfy regulators, but they can leave legitimate customers temporarily or indefinitely unable to move their funds. In the United States, exchanges face overlapping oversight from the SEC, the CFTC and state regulators, and disputes over customer access to funds have become a recurring theme in how digital-asset platforms are policed. Because balances sit with the exchange rather than in the user's own wallet, customers depend on the platform's internal review and appeals process rather than on self-custody.
updates.background_zh: Coinbase 这类托管型交易所代客户持有资产，并承担反洗钱与了解你的客户（KYC）义务，因此必须监控账户，并在某些情况下对账户加以限制。账户锁定是一种标准风控手段，本意是保护用户并满足监管要求，但也可能让合法客户暂时甚至长期无法动用资金。在美国，交易所需同时面对 SEC、CFTC 以及各州监管机构的多重监督，围绕客户资金访问权的争议已成为数字资产平台监管中的一个反复出现的主题。由于余额存放在交易所而非用户自己的钱包中，客户只能依赖平台内部的审核与申诉流程，而无法依靠自托管。

updates.detailed_summary_en: Coinbase is being sued for allegedly and unreasonably locking customers out of their accounts, raising concerns about user access to funds on the platform.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Coinbase is being sued for allegedly and unreasonably locking customers out of their accounts, raising concerns about user access to funds on the platform.
updates.market_impact_en: The exposure here is concentrated in Coinbase itself, as a major centralized custodian and a listed company, rather than in any specific token, with the transmission running through sentiment about exchange account-freeze practices and compliance risk instead of through asset supply or protocol liquidity. It also feeds into the broader debate over the trade-off between exchange risk controls and user access to funds, which is a recurring consideration for traders and institutions weighing whether to keep balances on centralized venues.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这里的风险敞口主要集中在 Coinbase 自身——作为大型中心化托管方和上市公司——而非某一特定代币，传导渠道是对交易所账户冻结做法与合规风险的情绪，而不是资产供给或协议层流动性。该案还会汇入关于“交易所风控与用户资金访问权之间如何权衡”的更广泛讨论，这是交易者和机构在考虑是否将资金留在中心化平台时会反复权衡的因素。

events.current_state_en: Binance has launched seven new USDT-margined perpetual futures contracts tied to stocks with up to 20x leverage, extending its derivatives lineup into equity exposure.
events.current_state_zh:
币安新上线了7款与股票挂钩的USDT本位永续合约，最高支持20倍杠杆。此次上线将该交易所的衍生品产品线从加密资产扩展到股票相关标的。

此举模糊了加密衍生品平台与传统股票市场之间的界限，让加密原生交易者无需券商账户即可获得带杠杆的股票敞口。由于币安是衍生品交易量最大的交易所，这一动作会抬高其他平台的竞争门槛，也让股票类衍生品更直接地进入监管视野。

由于合约以USDT本位计价，保证金、抵押与结算均使用该稳定币而非标的股票，因此产品提供的是合成价格敞口，不涉及实物股票交割。最高20倍的杠杆远高于受监管股票市场常见的保证金水平；同时作为永续合约，它们没有到期日，持仓可无限期维持，但需支付周期性资金费率。

Tokenized or equity-linked crypto products represent economic exposure to traditional stocks on a blockchain or exchange ledger, an area platforms such as Kraken have entered with tokenized stocks and ETFs. Crypto venues trade 24/7, whereas stock exchanges keep fixed sessions and close on weekends and holidays, which is part of the appeal of offering equity exposure in a perpetual-futures wrapper.

updates.current_state_en: Binance has launched seven new USDT-margined perpetual futures contracts tied to stocks with up to 20x leverage, extending its derivatives lineup into equity exposure.
updates.current_state_zh:
币安新上线了7款与股票挂钩的USDT本位永续合约，最高支持20倍杠杆。此次上线将该交易所的衍生品产品线从加密资产扩展到股票相关标的。

此举模糊了加密衍生品平台与传统股票市场之间的界限，让加密原生交易者无需券商账户即可获得带杠杆的股票敞口。由于币安是衍生品交易量最大的交易所，这一动作会抬高其他平台的竞争门槛，也让股票类衍生品更直接地进入监管视野。

由于合约以USDT本位计价，保证金、抵押与结算均使用该稳定币而非标的股票，因此产品提供的是合成价格敞口，不涉及实物股票交割。最高20倍的杠杆远高于受监管股票市场常见的保证金水平；同时作为永续合约，它们没有到期日，持仓可无限期维持，但需支付周期性资金费率。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Binance has launched seven new USDT-margined perpetual futures contracts tied to stocks with up to 20x leverage, extending its derivatives lineup into equity exposure.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Binance has launched seven new USDT-margined perpetual futures contracts tied to stocks with up to 20x leverage, extending its derivatives lineup into equity exposure.
updates.market_impact_en: The story transmits to crypto markets mainly through Binance's derivatives venue, where open interest, funding rates and liquidation activity in these stock contracts add a new source of leverage and possible arbitrage flow against tokenized-equity and spot share markets that close overnight. Because the underlying share markets are not continuously open, the contracts can absorb volatile repricing around weekends and holidays, making funding and liquidation dynamics on Binance the key channel to watch.
updates.market_impact_zh: 这条消息对加密市场的影响主要通过币安的衍生品平台传导：这些股票合约的未平仓量、资金费率与爆仓活动，为杠杆交易增加了新的来源，并可能与隔夜休市的代币化股票及现货股票市场之间产生套利流动。由于标的股票市场并非连续开市，这些合约在周末和节假日前后容易承接剧烈的价格重估，币安上的资金费率与清算动态由此成为关键观察渠道。

events.current_state_en: LSEG is planning to introduce 24/5 trading and a tokenized equity system, signaling deeper integration of blockchain-based settlement into mainstream exchange infrastructure.
events.current_state_zh:
据 Cryptonews.net 报道，伦敦证券交易所集团（LSEG）正计划推出24/5交易机制以及一套代币化股票系统。该方案将把交易时段延长至伦敦传统现货股票交易时间之外，并引入以区块链形式表示的上市公司股票。

一家主要的传统交易所运营商采用全天候交易与代币化结算，将模糊传统市场基础设施与加密原生平台之间的界限，并可能迫使竞争对手交易所和券商跟进。同时，这也强化了加密行业近年来大力推动的现实世界资产（RWA）代币化叙事。

所谓24/5，指的是从周日晚间到周五晚间连续交易、周末休市，而非真正的24/7全天候市场。代币化股票系统通常使用由托管实物股票1:1背书的区块链代币，这要求公司登记记录与链上数据保持同步；LSEG的这一计划目前被描述为方案，而非已经上线的产品。
events.title_en: LSEG plans 24/5 trading and tokenized equity system - Cryptonews.net
events.title_zh: 伦敦证券交易所集团计划推出24/5交易与代币化股票系统

updates.background_en: LSEG is the parent company of the London Stock Exchange and a major global provider of financial market infrastructure and data. Tokenized equity refers to digital representations of traditional company shares recorded on a blockchain, backed one-to-one by the underlying stock. Extended-hours trading is already offered by retail-focused brokers such as Robinhood and Trading 212, which let users trade stocks outside standard exchange sessions. LSEG's move would bring that model, and blockchain-based settlement, into mainstream exchange infrastructure.
updates.background_zh: LSEG 是伦敦证券交易所的母公司，也是全球主要的金融市场基础设施与数据提供商之一。代币化股票指的是记录在区块链上的传统公司股票的数字表示形式，并由对应的实物股票1:1背书。延长交易时段的做法已由 Robinhood、Trading 212 等面向散户的券商提供，允许用户在标准交易所时段之外交易股票。LSEG 的举措将把这种模式以及基于区块链的结算引入主流交易所基础设施。

updates.market_impact_en: The transmission path runs through the tokenization narrative: confirmation that a venue of LSEG's scale is pursuing blockchain-based equity representation could lift sentiment for tokenized-equity and RWA-related crypto assets, and for exchanges and custodians positioning around 24/5 trading. It also raises competitive pressure on crypto-native venues that currently dominate around-the-clock trading, as traditional infrastructure moves toward their hours and settlement models.
updates.market_impact_zh: 传导路径主要经由代币化叙事：LSEG 这一量级的交易场所确认推进基于区块链的股票表示形式，可能提振代币化股票及 RWA 相关加密资产的 sentiment，并利好围绕24/5交易布局的交易所与托管机构。同时，随着传统基础设施向全天候交易与类加密结算模式靠拢，目前主导全天候交易的加密原生平台也将面临竞争压力。

events.current_state_en: Slow Fog and OKX security researchers confirmed that the FomoPeek app contains kernel-level spy code, raising serious concerns about user data and wallet security.
events.current_state_zh:
区块链安全公司慢雾（SlowMist）与加密货币交易所OKX的安全团队联合确认，FomoPeek应用内嵌了运行于用户设备内核层的间谍代码，ababnews.com 报道了这一发现，blockchain.news 也发布了相应的警告。

内核级恶意代码位于常规应用沙箱之下，可访问普通权限无法触及的数据，因此这一发现直接威胁到已安装该应用用户的钱包密钥和个人数据；一家主流交易所安全团队的介入也表明，该威胁被视为可信风险而非猜测。

由于相关代码以内核权限运行，用户很难通过常规卸载应用的方式检测或清除，安全研究人员通常建议将受感染的设备视为已完全失陷，甚至需要重刷系统或彻底避免在该设备上进行任何钱包相关操作。
events.title_en: Slow Fog and OKX Confirm Kernel-Level Spy Code Embedded in FomoPeek App - ababnews.com
events.title_zh: 慢雾与OKX确认FomoPeek应用内嵌内核级间谍代码

updates.background_en: The kernel is the core of an operating system that mediates all access to memory, storage, network interfaces and input devices; code running at kernel level therefore bypasses the sandboxing that normally isolates one mobile app from another. SlowMist is a blockchain security firm known for wallet and smart-contract incident response and threat intelligence, while OKX is one of the largest global crypto exchanges and maintains its own security research capability. Mobile apps remain a common distribution channel for crypto-targeted malware, because users frequently sideload apps or install niche tools that never go through a rigorous app-store review.
updates.background_zh: 内核是操作系统的核心，负责调度对内存、存储、网络接口和输入设备的全部访问，因此运行在内核层的代码可以绕过通常用于隔离移动应用之间的沙箱机制。慢雾是一家以钱包与智能合约安全事件响应和威胁情报著称的区块链安全公司，而OKX是全球最大的加密货币交易所之一，拥有自己的安全研究能力。移动应用仍是针对加密货币的恶意软件常见的传播渠道，因为用户经常侧载应用或安装未经严格应用商店审核的小众工具。
updates.current_state_en: Slow Fog and OKX security researchers confirmed that the FomoPeek app contains kernel-level spy code, raising serious concerns about user data and wallet security.

区块链安全公司慢雾（SlowMist）与加密货币交易所OKX的安全团队联合确认，FomoPeek应用内嵌了运行于用户设备内核层的间谍代码，ababnews.com 报道了这一发现，blockchain.news 也发布了相应的警告。

内核级恶意代码位于常规应用沙箱之下，可访问普通权限无法触及的数据，因此这一发现直接威胁到已安装该应用用户的钱包密钥和个人数据；一家主流交易所安全团队的介入也表明，该威胁被视为可信风险而非猜测。

由于相关代码以内核权限运行，用户很难通过常规卸载应用的方式检测或清除，安全研究人员通常建议将受感染的设备视为已完全失陷，甚至需要重刷系统或彻底避免在该设备上进行任何钱包相关操作。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Slow Fog and OKX security researchers confirmed that the FomoPeek app contains kernel-level spy code, raising serious concerns about user data and wallet security.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Slow Fog and OKX security researchers confirmed that the FomoPeek app contains kernel-level spy code, raising serious concerns about user data and wallet security.
updates.market_impact_en: The transmission channel here is user-side custody risk rather than protocol-level or price-level exposure: wallets that interacted with the compromised app could be drained by attackers, creating potential forced outflows from affected addresses, while the broader effect is a sentiment and trust hit to third-party crypto mobile apps and to app-distribution channels promoted through exchanges and Web3 campaigns. The finding does not appear systemic to any major venue, so its market footprint is likely limited to the assets held by users of the affected app.
updates.market_impact_zh: 此处的传导渠道是用户侧托管风险，而非协议层或价格层面的敞口：与受感染应用交互过的钱包可能被攻击者盗空，从而造成受影响地址的被动资金外流；更广泛的影响则是对第三方加密移动应用以及通过交易所和Web3活动推广的应用分发渠道造成信心与信任冲击。该发现似乎并不构成对任何主流平台的系统性风险，因此其市场波及范围很可能仅限于受影响应用的用户所持有的资产。

区块链安全公司慢雾（SlowMist）与加密货币交易所OKX的安全团队联合确认，FomoPeek应用内嵌了运行于用户设备内核层的间谍代码，ababnews.com 报道了这一发现，blockchain.news 也发布了相应的警告。

内核级恶意代码位于常规应用沙箱之下，可访问普通权限无法触及的数据，因此这一发现直接威胁到已安装该应用用户的钱包密钥和个人数据；一家主流交易所安全团队的介入也表明，该威胁被视为可信风险而非猜测。

由于相关代码以内核权限运行，用户很难通过常规卸载应用的方式检测或清除，安全研究人员通常建议将受感染的设备视为已完全失陷，甚至需要重刷系统或彻底避免在该设备上进行任何钱包相关操作。

events.current_state_en: Grayscale's Zcash ETF (ZCSH) has accumulated $914.53 million in net assets less than a month after its NYSE Arca debut, coinciding with ZEC roughly doubling above $1,500 and futures open interest hitting a record ~$3.5 billion.
events.current_state_zh:
Grayscale旗下的Zcash ETF（代码ZCSH）自8月25日在NYSE Arca上市以来，净资产规模已达9.1453亿美元，累计净流入为2.7095亿美元，距离10亿美元门槛仅差约8500万美元。同期ZEC价格大致翻倍，9月19日交易价格约为1540美元，而ZEC期货未平仓合约规模升至约35亿美元的历史高位，期货成交量也自6月初以来首次突破100亿美元。

这是一个清晰的案例：单一山寨币通过受监管、可由券商账户买入的渠道获得资金流入，同时其衍生品市场积累创纪录的杠杆头寸，意味着机构资金与投机杠杆正在同一资产上相互强化。这也检验了由Grayscale信托转换而来的产品能否向10亿美元这一山寨币ETF“可行规模”基准靠拢，其结果将影响发行方与监管机构对待同类单一资产产品的态度。

由于ZCSH实际持有ZEC，价格上涨会与新增份额申购一起推高基金内部已有资产的价值，这正是其9.1453亿美元资产规模超过2.7095亿美元累计净流入三倍以上的原因。Grayscale于9月18日宣布进行1拆3的前瞻性拆股，9月28日收盘时登记在册的股东每持1份将获得2份新增份额，分配于9月29日收盘后进行，拆股后每份份额对应的净资产值降至拆股前约三分之一。

updates.background_en: Zcash is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that uses zero-knowledge proofs to shield transaction details, and it caps supply at 21 million coins with a Bitcoin-style halving schedule. Grayscale operates crypto investment vehicles that convert into exchange-traded funds listed on U.S. exchanges; ZCSH is its spot Zcash ETF on NYSE Arca, giving ordinary brokerage accounts a regulated way to gain ZEC exposure without holding the token directly. Futures open interest measures the total value of outstanding derivative contracts and is often read as a proxy for how much leveraged capital is committed to an asset. NU7 is Zcash's planned seventh major network upgrade, an advisory vote on which this month saw about 2.4 million ZEC participate, roughly two-thirds of eligible supply.
updates.background_zh: Zcash是一种以隐私为核心的加密货币，通过零知识证明隐藏交易细节，其供应量上限为2100万枚，并采用与比特币类似的减半机制。Grayscale运营的加密投资工具可转换为在美国交易所上市的ETF，ZCSH即其登陆NYSE Arca的现货Zcash ETF，使普通券商账户无需直接持有代币即可合规获得ZEC敞口。期货未平仓合约衡量未结算衍生品合约的总价值，常被用来反映投入某资产的杠杆资金规模。NU7是Zcash计划中的第七次重大网络升级，本月围绕其进行的咨询性投票约有240万枚ZEC参与，约占具备投票资格供应量的三分之二。

updates.market_impact_en: The main transmission channel is structural: ZCSH creates a persistent, brokerage-accessible bid for ZEC that shows up as fund creations and NAV growth, while record open interest near $3.5 billion and elevated turnover make the spot market more sensitive to liquidations if leveraged positions unwind. The planned 3-for-1 split changes per-share pricing and liquidity characteristics of ZCSH itself without altering the fund's underlying ZEC holdings, and the advisory votes on retaining the halving schedule and delaying NSM reissuance to 2031 keep ZEC's 21 million supply cap and scarcity narrative intact alongside expanding regulated access.
updates.market_impact_zh: 主要传导渠道是结构性的：ZCSH为ZEC带来持续且可通过券商账户进入的买盘，体现为基金份额申购与净资产增长；而接近35亿美元的历史高位未平仓合约和放大的成交量，使得一旦杠杆头寸平仓，现货市场对连环清算会更加敏感。计划中的1拆3拆股改变了ZCSH自身的每份价格与流动性特征，但并不改变基金持有的ZEC底层资产；同时，关于保留减半机制、将NSM再发行推迟至2031年的咨询性投票结果，使ZEC的2100万枚供应上限与稀缺性叙事在受监管准入扩大的背景下得以延续。

events.current_state_en: Solana reduced its target slot time from 300 milliseconds to 250 milliseconds, marking a nearly 17% speedup in block production and the network's third such optimization since August.
events.current_state_zh:
Solana 将其目标出块时间（slot time）从 300 毫秒下调至 250 毫秒，出块节奏加快约 17%，这是该网络自 8 月以来的第三次提速。此次调整是 SIMD-0525 提案四个规划阶段中的第三步，该提案已把 slot 时间从创世时的 400 毫秒依次降至 350 毫秒、300 毫秒，再到如今的 250 毫秒。

更短的 slot 缩短了区块链结算与传统交易所那种近乎即时确认之间的差距，主要惠及对延迟敏感的应用，例如预言机和自动做市商。其意义在于，Solana 正是靠执行速度的新鲜度来争夺高频交易和 DeFi 活动，尽管网络的原始交易吞吐量并未改变。

这并非容量升级：每个更短的 slot 被分配的计算量和数据量也按比例减少，因此网络是以更小、更频繁的片段承载同样的总负载。由于一个 epoch 固定为 432,000 个 slot，slot 时间压缩使预期 epoch 时长从约 36 小时缩短至约 30 小时，从而也悄然加快了质押奖励和验证者排期；最后一步降至 200 毫秒尚未确定主网激活日期，且只有在区块跳票率（block-skip rate）保持稳定的前提下才会推进。
events.title_en: Solana's Heartbeat Quickens: Block Times Fall 17% in Latest Speed Upgrade
events.title_zh: Solana 第三次提速：目标出块时间降至 250 毫秒

updates.background_en: A slot is the short window handed to one validator—a computer that helps run the network and gets paid for it—to build and publish a block, which is a batch of confirmed transactions; shrink that window and the whole chain's heartbeat quickens. Validators keep the leader role, the temporary right to build blocks, for four consecutive slots before handing it off, so at 250ms per slot that control window shrinks from 1.2 seconds to one second. SIMD-0525 is Solana's formal process for proposing and approving network changes, and the same instinct to narrow the gap between settlement and instant confirmation also drives Alpenglow, a separate consensus overhaul being tested to cut transaction finality from a 12.8-second wait to something closer to instant.
updates.background_zh: slot 是分配给某个验证者（validator，即帮助运行网络并获得报酬的计算机）用于构建并发布区块的短暂时间窗口，而区块就是一批已确认交易；这个窗口一缩短，整条链的“心跳”就会加快。验证者会连续四个 slot 持有领袖角色（leader，即临时构建区块的权利）再交接出去，因此在每个 slot 250 毫秒下，这一控制窗口从 1.2 秒缩短至 1 秒。SIMD-0525 是 Solana 提出并批准网络变更的正式流程，而同样旨在缩小结算与即时确认之间差距的思路也推动了 Alpenglow——一项正在测试的独立共识改造，目标是把交易最终性（finality）从 12.8 秒的等待缩短到接近即时。

updates.market_impact_en: The transmission runs through Solana's DeFi infrastructure rather than through supply or regulation: fresher price feeds and tighter execution windows can make on-chain oracles and automated market makers more competitive with centralized venues, which is a factor in how liquidity and trading volume may be distributed across SOL-denominated DeFi venues. Compressed epochs also shift the timing of staking reward accrual and validator scheduling, a consideration for staking service providers and delegators.
updates.market_impact_zh: 其传导路径在于 Solana 的 DeFi 基础设施，而非代币供给或监管：更新鲜的价格喂价和更紧的执行窗口，可能使链上预言机与自动做市商相对中心化交易所更具竞争力，从而影响流动性与交易量在以 SOL 计价的 DeFi 场所之间的分布。epoch 压缩也会改变质押奖励累积和验证者排期的时间节奏，这是质押服务商与委托者需要关注的变量。

events.current_state_en: Bastion received preliminary conditional OCC approval for a national trust bank charter to offer stablecoin custody, wallets, payment infrastructure, and white-label issuance under federal supervision.
events.current_state_zh:
稳定币基础设施提供商 Bastion 表示，美国货币监理署（OCC）已向其拟设的 Bastion Platforms National Trust Company 授予国家信托银行牌照的初步有条件批准。该牌照在 Bastion 已持有的州级牌照（包括 2025 年 2 月获得的纽约信托牌照）之外增加了 OCC 的联邦监管，该实体将在单一联邦监管机构下提供稳定币托管与钱包、支付基础设施以及白标发行服务。

这是稳定币基础设施领域的重要监管里程碑，因为它使单一联邦监管实体能够同时打包托管、钱包、支付与白标发行，而不必逐州拼凑牌照。此前 Circle 和 BitGo 已获得最终批准、Ripple 也拿到有条件批准，表明国家信托银行牌照已成为加密行业进入美国银行体系的主要通道。

该批准是初步的且有条件，而且这家拟设信托银行不能吸收存款或发放贷款，因此并非传统商业银行，短期系统性影响有限。OCC 规则要求此类牌照必须在固定期限内开业，Paxos 早前的有条件批准就因未在 18 个月的运营期限内达标而在 2023 年 3 月失效，因此落地时间表是关键变量。
events.title_en: Bastion wins conditional OCC approval for national trust bank charter
events.title_zh: Bastion 获 OCC 有条件批准国家信托银行牌照

updates.background_en: A national trust bank charter is a federal banking license granted by the OCC that permits fiduciary and custody activities but not deposit-taking or lending; for decades it served corporate trustees, and since 2025 it has become the crypto industry's preferred entry point into the US banking system. The OCC clarified in May 2025 that banks may engage in crypto-asset custody and execution services, and in July 2025 the OCC, the Federal Reserve and the FDIC jointly issued a statement on crypto-asset safekeeping by banking organizations. Bastion had raised $14.6 million in a September 2025 round led by Coinbase Ventures, with participation from Sony, Samsung's investment subsidiary, Andreessen Horowitz's crypto arm and Hashed.
updates.background_zh: 国家信托银行牌照是 OCC 授予的联邦银行牌照，允许开展受托与托管业务，但不允许吸收存款或发放贷款；它长期服务于企业受托机构，而自 2025 年起成为加密行业进入美国银行体系的首选路径。OCC 于 2025 年 5 月明确银行可从事加密资产托管与执行服务，2025 年 7 月 OCC、美联储与 FDIC 又联合发布了关于银行机构加密资产保管的声明。Bastion 曾在 2025 年 9 月完成由 Coinbase Ventures 领投的 1460 万美元融资，索尼、三星旗下投资子公司、Andreessen Horowitz 的加密部门以及 Hashed 参投。
updates.current_state_en: Bastion received preliminary conditional OCC approval for a national trust bank charter to offer stablecoin custody, wallets, payment infrastructure, and white-label issuance under federal supervision.
updates.current_state_zh:
稳定币基础设施提供商 Bastion 表示，美国货币监理署（OCC）已向其拟设的 Bastion Platforms National Trust Company 授予国家信托银行牌照的初步有条件批准。该牌照在 Bastion 已持有的州级牌照（包括 2025 年 2 月获得的纽约信托牌照）之外增加了 OCC 的联邦监管，该实体将在单一联邦监管机构下提供稳定币托管与钱包、支付基础设施以及白标发行服务。

这是稳定币基础设施领域的重要监管里程碑，因为它使单一联邦监管实体能够同时打包托管、钱包、支付与白标发行，而不必逐州拼凑牌照。此前 Circle 和 BitGo 已获得最终批准、Ripple 也拿到有条件批准，表明国家信托银行牌照已成为加密行业进入美国银行体系的主要通道。

该批准是初步的且有条件，而且这家拟设信托银行不能吸收存款或发放贷款，因此并非传统商业银行，短期系统性影响有限。OCC 规则要求此类牌照必须在固定期限内开业，Paxos 早前的有条件批准就因未在 18 个月的运营期限内达标而在 2023 年 3 月失效，因此落地时间表是关键变量。
updates.detailed_summary_en: Bastion received preliminary conditional OCC approval for a national trust bank charter to offer stablecoin custody, wallets, payment infrastructure, and white-label issuance under federal supervision.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Bastion received preliminary conditional OCC approval for a national trust bank charter to offer stablecoin custody, wallets, payment infrastructure, and white-label issuance under federal supervision.
updates.market_impact_en: The charter routes institutional stablecoin custody and issuance demand into a federally supervised entity, which can pull custody and white-label issuance flows toward OCC-regulated venues and reinforce the compliance advantage of federally chartered players over state-licensed competitors. It also widens the set of regulated counterparties available to stablecoin issuers and institutional allocators, though the prohibition on deposits and lending caps how far that balance-sheet effect can extend.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该牌照把机构稳定币托管与发行需求导入联邦监管实体，可能推动托管与白标发行业务流向受 OCC 监管的场所，并强化联邦牌照机构相对州牌照竞争者的合规优势。它也扩大了稳定币发行方与机构配置方可选的受监管交易对手范围，但禁止吸储与放贷的限制决定了这种资产负债表效应能够延伸的范围。

events.current_state_en: PlanetScale introduced Tin, a full-text search capability for Postgres offered exclusively on its cloud platform, prompting Hacker News debate about its performance, cloud lock-in, and comparison to existing Postgres FTS and rival extensions.
events.current_state_zh:
PlanetScale 发布了 TIN（Text INdex），这是面向 PlanetScale Postgres 的全文搜索扩展，提供专为搜索设计的倒排索引类型、BM25 相关性排序以及 TINQL 查询语言。这是 PlanetScale 为其 Postgres 产品推出的首个搜索能力，公司称该功能是客户呼声最高的需求之一。

这让 PlanetScale 加入了一场数据库厂商竞相把搜索能力直接内置到 Postgres 的竞赛，赛道上的玩家已包括 ParadeDB 的 pg_search、Timescale 的 pg_textsearch，以及 Neon 和 Databricks 的搜索功能。如果这些方案逐渐成熟，如今在 Postgres 之外单独运行 Elasticsearch 之类搜索引擎的团队，或许可以少维护一个系统组件。

根据 PlanetScale 的文档和社区反馈，TIN 的性能表现仅在其云服务上可用：相关的开源本地扩展（github.com/planetscale/lead）主要用于测试 TINQL 语法，性能特征与云端版本并不一致。基准测试数据由厂商自己提供而非独立第三方评测，因此团队应结合自身实际负载进行验证。
events.title_en: Tin: full-text search for Postgres
events.title_zh: PlanetScale 发布 Postgres 全文搜索扩展 TIN

updates.background_en: Postgres already ships built-in full-text search through the tsvector, tsquery and ts_rank functions, which support functional indexing and query optimization, but many developers find its ranking quality and index sizes limiting compared with dedicated search engines. TIN-style extensions target that gap by adding an inverted index and BM25 scoring — the ranking algorithm popularized by Lucene and used by Elasticsearch and SQLite's FTS5 — so relevance ordering behaves more like a purpose-built search engine while the data stays inside Postgres.
updates.background_zh: Postgres 本身已内置全文搜索，通过 tsvector、tsquery 和 ts_rank 等函数实现，并支持函数索引与查询优化，但不少开发者认为其相关性排序质量和索引体积不如专用搜索引擎。TIN 这类扩展正是瞄准这一差距，引入倒排索引和 BM25 打分算法——即 Lucene 推广、Elasticsearch 与 SQLite FTS5 采用的排序算法——从而让相关性排序更接近专用搜索引擎，同时数据仍留在 Postgres 内部。
updates.community_discussion_en: Hacker News commenters were split: skeptics asked why they should adopt a non-core, cloud-only extension when Postgres already has sophisticated built-in full-text search (tsvector/tsquery/ts_rank) and pointed to weak experiences with ts_query's large indexes, while others read the wave of vendor search features as a sign of AI-era coding productivity. Several noted the local version is syntax-only and that comparable alternatives already exist (ParadeDB pg_search, Timescale pg_textsearch, Neon/Databricks Lakebase Search), and one commenter highlighted SQLite FTS's Lucene-style queries as a benchmark Postgres has yet to match.
updates.community_discussion_zh: Hacker News 上的评论意见分化：质疑者认为 Postgres 已内置相当成熟的全文搜索（tsvector/tsquery/ts_rank），不明白为何要采用一个非核心、仅限云端的扩展，并提到 ts_query 索引体积过大的糟糕体验；也有人把这一波厂商搜索功能视为 AI 时代编码效率提升的体现。多位评论者指出本地版本只用于语法测试，且同类方案早已存在（ParadeDB pg_search、Timescale pg_textsearch、Neon/Databricks 的 Lakebase Search），还有人提到 SQLite FTS 开箱即支持 Lucene 风格查询，是 Postgres 尚未企及的参照。

events.current_state_en: A researcher used Claude to port CADO-NFS to GPUs and orchestrated up to 2048 GPUs over ten days (~30 GPU-years) to factor the 896-bit RSA-896 number with existing number field sieve algorithms.
events.current_state_zh: A researcher used Claude to port CADO-NFS to GPUs and orchestrated up to 2048 GPUs over ten days (~30 GPU-years) to factor the 896-bit RSA-896 number with existing number field sieve algorithms.
events.title_en: RSA-896
events.title_zh: RSA-896

updates.background_en: The general number field sieve (NFS) is the most efficient known classical algorithm for factoring large integers, with sub-exponential but still extremely steep runtime growth. CADO-NFS (Crible Algébrique: Distribution, Optimisation - Number Field Sieve) is a complete open-source C/C++ implementation of NFS for factoring integers and computing discrete logarithms, developed by the French research institute INRIA. RSA Laboratories ran the RSA Factoring Challenge from 1991, offering cash prizes for factoring semiprimes of increasing size up to 2048 bits; the contest formally ended in 2007, but several of the numbers, including RSA-896, remained unfactored, with RSA-768 standing as the last major public record. RSA-896 is a 270-decimal-digit semiprime and had been listed as an open challenge for well over a decade.
updates.background_zh: 通用数域筛法（NFS）是已知最有效的经典大整数分解算法，其运行时间增长为亚指数级，但仍然极其陡峭。CADO-NFS（Crible Algébrique: Distribution, Optimisation - Number Field Sieve）是由法国研究机构INRIA开发的、完整的开源C/C++数域筛法实现，用于整数分解和有限域离散对数计算。RSA实验室从1991年起举办“RSA分解挑战”，为分解规模逐级增大的半素数（最大到2048位）提供现金奖励；该竞赛在2007年正式结束，但包括RSA-896在内的若干数字一直未被分解，其中RSA-768是最后一项重大公开记录。RSA-896是一个270位十进制数字的半素数，被列为公开挑战已超过十年。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters focused on the economics of idle compute rather than the cryptography: one argued that if a GPU cluster is already reserved and paid for, using spare cycles on math puzzles is effectively free, though mining crypto would be more financially rational, while others read the story as bearish for Anthropic (spare capacity being spent on puzzles) and for data-center buildout narratives if idle compute can be diverted from LLM training.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论区的关注点集中在闲置算力的经济学，而非密码学本身：有人认为，既然GPU集群已经预留并付费，把空闲周期用来解数学题实际上等于免费，尽管用来挖加密货币在财务上更划算；也有人把这条消息解读为对Anthropic偏空（闲置产能被用来做题），以及对数据中心扩张叙事偏空——如果闲置算力可以被从大模型训练中挪作他用的话。

updates.market_impact_en: Bitcoin and Ethereum rely on elliptic-curve cryptography (ECDSA over secp256k1) rather than RSA, so this result carries little direct cryptographic exposure for major crypto assets; the more plausible transmission channel is sentiment in GPU compute markets, where visible evidence of large volumes of scavengeable idle data-center capacity feeds into the supply-and-demand narrative surrounding decentralized GPU compute networks and AI compute tokens.
updates.market_impact_zh: 比特币和以太坊依赖的是椭圆曲线密码学（基于secp256k1的ECDSA），而非RSA，因此这一结果对主流加密资产几乎没有直接的密码学敞口；更可能的传导渠道是GPU算力市场的情绪面——大量可被“捡漏”利用的闲置数据中心算力被公开验证，会影响到围绕去中心化GPU算力网络和AI算力代币的供需叙事。

events.current_state_en: Qwen released Qwen-Image-2.1, a compact 7B open-weight image generation model with native transparency and markedly improved text rendering, though under a more restrictive license than earlier Qwen releases.
events.current_state_zh: Qwen released Qwen-Image-2.1, a compact 7B open-weight image generation model with native transparency and markedly improved text rendering, though under a more restrictive license than earlier Qwen releases.
events.title_en: Qwen-Image-2.1: Compact, efficient, and unified image creation
events.title_zh: Qwen-Image-2.1: Compact, efficient, and unified image creation

updates.background_en: Open-weight image models publish their trained parameters so anyone can download and run them locally, as opposed to proprietary APIs such as GPT-Image-2 or Ideogram that are only accessible through a hosted service. Most of these models are diffusion transformers (DiT): a text encoder converts the prompt into conditioning signals, and a stack of transformer layers iteratively denoises random noise into an image. Two capabilities are technically hard: rendering accurate small text, because the model must learn glyph structure rather than just shapes, and emitting an alpha (transparency) channel, because typical training pipelines produce flattened RGB images only, so background removal is usually a separate post-processing step. Qwen's predecessor Qwen-Image was a 20B MMDiT model released in August 2025, and Qwen-Image-Layered, a dedicated transparency model, arrived in December 2025.
updates.background_zh: 开源权重图像模型会公开发布训练好的参数，任何人都可以下载并在本地运行，这与 GPT-Image-2、Ideogram 等只能通过托管服务调用的闭源 API 形成对比。此类模型大多采用扩散 Transformer（DiT）架构：文本编码器把提示词转成条件信号，再由一叠 Transformer 层逐步从随机噪声中去噪生成图像。其中有两项能力在技术上格外困难：一是准确渲染小字号文字，因为模型必须学会字形结构而不只是形状；二是输出 alpha 透明通道，因为常规训练管线只产生压平后的 RGB 图像，抠图通常要依赖单独的后处理步骤。Qwen 的前代产品 Qwen-Image 是 2025 年 8 月发布的 20B MMDiT 模型，而专攻透明生成的 Qwen-Image-Layered 则于 2025 年 12 月亮相。
updates.community_discussion_en: Commenters were broadly positive on the model's practical value: it is far smaller than the 20B Qwen-Image 1, and one developer running a prompt-to-UI design site called its small-text fidelity much better than anything else currently on the open-weight market. The two recurring concerns were the much more restrictive license compared with Apache-licensed earlier Qwen models, and weak prompt adherence — one user asking for glass 3D text in a specific city got broken text on a plain white background — while others noted that local image generation now feels further ahead than local code generation.
updates.community_discussion_zh: 评论者总体上肯定其实用价值：它比 20B 的 Qwen-Image 1 小得多，一位运营提示词生成 UI 设计网站的开发者称，其小字号文字保真度明显优于当前开源权重市场上的其他模型。两大反复出现的担忧是：许可证比此前采用 Apache 许可的 Qwen 模型严格得多；以及提示词遵循能力偏弱——有用户要求生成某个城市中的玻璃质感 3D 文字，结果只得到白底上破碎的文字——同时也有人认为，本地图像生成目前已比本地代码生成走得更远。

updates.background_en: A pre-IPO perpetual is a cash-settled derivative that tracks the anticipated public valuation of a company that is still private; because there is no listed share price, the contract has no external spot oracle to anchor to. Tokenized stocks are blockchain-based instruments designed to mirror the economic exposure of real equities without transferring ownership. OpenAI and Anthropic are private AI developers that have not yet listed, so exposure to them has traditionally required private-market access rather than a public exchange.
updates.background_zh: 上市前永续合约是一种现金结算的衍生品，追踪的是仍处于私有状态的公司在上市后可能达到的估值；由于不存在公开挂牌的股价，这类合约没有可锚定的外部现货价格来源。代币化股票则是基于区块链的工具，旨在复制真实股票的经济敞口，但并不转移所有权。OpenAI和Anthropic都是尚未上市的私营AI公司，因此过去想要获得其敞口通常只能通过私募市场，而非公开交易所。

Because the contracts reference unlisted companies, pricing depends on venue-determined valuation and funding mechanics rather than an observable spot market, a structure that can widen price dislocations around funding resets or IPO-related news.

updates.background_en: Pre-IPO investing means buying a stake in a company before it lists on a stock exchange, a market traditionally intermediated by venture funds and specialized secondary platforms. Tokenization turns such an asset into a blockchain-based token, and the broader real-world-asset (RWA) sector applies the same approach to stocks, real estate and private markets. Binance Wallet is the exchange's self-custody wallet, and PancakeSwap is the largest decentralized exchange on the BNB Chain, which is why the campaigns are being hosted there rather than on Binance's centralized order book.
updates.background_zh: Pre-IPO 投资指的是在公司登陆证券交易所之前买入其股份，这一市场传统上由风投基金和专业二级交易平台作为中介。代币化则是把这类资产转化为基于区块链的代币，而更广泛的现实世界资产（RWA）赛道正是把同样的方法用于股票、房地产和私募市场。币安钱包是币安的自托管钱包，PancakeSwap 则是 BNB Chain 上规模最大的去中心化交易所，因此这些活动由 PancakeSwap 承接，而非在币安的中心化订单簿上进行。

events.current_state_en:
A reported security flaw in Polymarket's identity and authentication flow allowed attackers to gain access to existing user accounts, according to a Gizmodo report. The issue is described as account-takeover-style access rather than an exploit of the platform's smart contracts or market settlement logic.

Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market, so account takeover there exposes user balances and open positions directly and undermines confidence in how the platform verifies identity and recovers accounts. It also highlights the security seam that exists on crypto platforms where a KYC/identity layer sits on top of on-chain asset custody.

The reported attack path is an identity-layer weakness that lets someone log into an existing account, the classic pattern of an account takeover (ATO) rather than a smart-contract or oracle failure, so the risk concentrates in the account and custody layer instead of the trading engine. The reported flaw concerns access to accounts that already existed, meaning affected users would not necessarily have created anything new or interacted with a malicious contract.
events.current_state_zh:
据 Gizmodo 报道，Polymarket 的身份验证环节存在一处安全漏洞，使攻击者得以登入已有用户的账户。该问题被描述为账户接管式的访问，而非针对平台智能合约或市场结算逻辑的攻击。

Polymarket 是全球规模最大的预测市场，账户被接管意味着用户的余额与未平仓头寸可能直接暴露在风险中，并动摇用户对平台身份核验与账户找回机制的信心。这也凸显了加密平台在 KYC 身份层与链上资产托管层之间存在的安全缝隙。

据报的攻击路径属于身份层的弱点，使攻击者能够登入既有账户，这是典型的账户接管（ATO）模式，而非智能合约或预言机层面的失效，因此风险集中在账户与托管层而非撮合逻辑。漏洞针对的是已经存在的账户，这意味着受害者未必需要创建新账户或与恶意合约进行交互。

events.title_en: FomoPeek iPhone App Found Carrying iOS Exploit Kit That Steals Crypto Wallet Keys - finance.biggo.com
events.title_zh: FomoPeek iPhone App Found Carrying iOS Exploit Kit That Steals Crypto Wallet Keys - finance.biggo.com

updates.background_en: An iOS exploit kit is a packaged collection of vulnerabilities and exploitation code that lets an attacker break out of the iOS sandbox — the isolation layer that normally prevents one app from reading another app's data or the wider file system. Crypto wallets on phones store private keys or seed phrases locally for self-custody, so anything that escapes the sandbox can potentially copy those secrets and let an attacker drain funds remotely. Whale-tracking apps are a natural lure because they ask users to link or paste wallet addresses, giving them a plausible reason to install and keep the app running on a device that also holds wallet software.
updates.background_zh: iOS 漏洞利用套件是一组打包好的漏洞与利用代码，可让攻击者突破 iOS 沙盒——即通常阻止某个应用读取其他应用数据或访问更广泛文件系统的隔离层。手机上的加密钱包为实现自托管，会在本地保存私钥或助记词，因此任何能逃出沙盒的代码都可能复制这些秘密信息，使攻击者远程盗走资金。巨鲸追踪类应用是天然的诱饵，因为它们会要求用户关联或粘贴钱包地址，从而让用户有合理理由在同时存放钱包软件的设备上安装并长期运行该应用。

updates.market_impact_en: The exposure runs through self-custody key exfiltration on Solana, Ethereum and TRON mobile wallets, so the immediate risk sits with individual hot-wallet holders rather than exchange or protocol reserves. A confirmed consumer-app-based key stealer can shift sentiment toward hardware and air-gapped custody and intensify scrutiny of mobile app store review for crypto apps.
updates.market_impact_zh: 风险传导路径是 Solana、以太坊和 TRON 移动钱包自托管私钥被窃取，因此直接受影响的是个人的热钱包持有者，而非交易所或协议储备。一款经确认可窃取密钥的消费级应用可能推动市场情绪转向硬件钱包与离线隔离式托管，并加剧对加密类移动应用商店审核机制的审视。

updates.background_en: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and users, and it spent years operating across jurisdictions without clear local licences before settling major US enforcement actions in 2023, including a DOJ guilty plea over Bank Secrecy Act and money-transmitting violations. The UAE became central to its rehabilitation strategy: in 2025 Mubadala, the UAE's sovereign wealth fund, bought a $2 billion stake, and in December 2025 the Financial Services Regulatory Authority of ADGM in Abu Dhabi authorised Binance.com under a comprehensive framework, making it the first crypto exchange with a global licence under that regime.
updates.background_zh: 按交易量和用户数计算，币安是全球最大的加密货币交易所。在 2023 年与美国监管机构达成重大和解（包括就违反《银行保密法》和未注册为货币传输业务向美国司法部认罪）之前，它曾多年在多个司法辖区缺乏明确本地牌照的情况下运营。阿联酋随后成为其重建信誉战略的核心：2025 年阿联酋主权财富基金 Mubadala 入股 20 亿美元；2025 年 12 月，阿布扎比国际金融中心 ADGM 的金融服务监管局（FSRA）依据一套全面监管框架正式批准币安全球平台 Binance.com，使其成为首个在该框架下获得全球牌照的加密交易所。

events.title_en: ZetaChain votes to shut down Layer 1 network and move ZETA to Solana
events.title_zh: ZetaChain 持有人批准逐步关停 L1、将 ZETA 迁移至 Solana 的计划

updates.background_en: ZetaChain was built with the Cosmos SDK and Tendermint consensus and included an Ethereum Virtual Machine-compatible execution layer called zEVM, positioning itself as a base layer for omnichain smart contracts and cross-chain messaging between otherwise separate networks. Anuma is the same team's private AI chat product, which builds an encrypted memory of a user's conversations that stays on the user's device and travels across different AI models. Solana is a high-throughput Layer 1, and SPL is its native token standard, so migrating ZETA means issuing the asset on Solana and retiring it on its original chain.
updates.background_zh: ZetaChain 基于 Cosmos SDK 和 Tendermint 共识构建，并包含一个兼容以太坊虚拟机的执行层 zEVM，定位为支持全链（omnichain）智能合约和跨链消息传递的基础层。Anuma 是同一团队的私密 AI 聊天产品，它会为用户对话建立加密记忆，数据保存在用户设备上并可跨不同 AI 模型使用。Solana 是一条高吞吐量的 Layer 1，SPL 是其原生代币标准，因此 ZETA 迁移意味着在 Solana 上发行该资产并在原链上将其退出。
updates.current_state_en: ZetaChain token holders voted to shut down the project's Layer 1 network and move the ZETA asset to Solana, with the team pivoting to its private AI app Anuma, though the migration requires one more vote.
updates.current_state_zh: ZetaChain 代币持有者投票决定关闭该项目的 Layer 1 网络，并将 ZETA 资产迁移至 Solana，团队将转向其私有 AI 应用 Anuma，但此次迁移还需再进行一次投票。
updates.detailed_summary_en: ZetaChain token holders voted to shut down the project's Layer 1 network and move the ZETA asset to Solana, with the team pivoting to its private AI app Anuma, though the migration requires one more vote.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ZetaChain token holders voted to shut down the project's Layer 1 network and move the ZETA asset to Solana, with the team pivoting to its private AI app Anuma, though the migration requires one more vote.
updates.market_impact_en: The vote puts the ZETA asset on a path toward a chain migration and the retirement of its original network, which affects spot liquidity and redemption mechanics on exchanges that list ZETA, and shifts validator and bridge-related activity away from the ZetaChain ecosystem. A successful migration would also add another Solana SPL asset to that ecosystem's token universe, while the wind-down itself feeds broader sentiment about the sustainability of smaller Layer 1 networks.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该投票使 ZETA 资产进入链迁移通道，其原链将逐步退出，这会影响上线 ZETA 的交易所的现货流动性与兑换机制，并使验证者及跨链桥相关活动从 ZetaChain 生态中流出。若迁移顺利完成，Solana 生态的代币版图中将新增一枚 SPL 资产，而此次关停本身也会强化市场对小型 Layer 1 网络可持续性的讨论情绪。

updates.detailed_summary_en: ZetaChain tokenholders passed governance proposal 68 on Sunday with 99.4% support and 58% participation, exceeding the network’s 40% quorum, to wind down its Cosmos-based layer 1 and migrate native ZETA to Solana as an SPL token through a 1:1 conversion with the same ticker and total supply. According to the proposal, the vote does not immediately trigger ZetaChain’s shutdown or migration; core contributors will submit a second proposal detailing the withdrawal window for assets linked to other blockchains, snapshot block height, shutdown timetable, token claim process and exchange conversion period, while validators continue operating and staking rewards continue during the transition.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: ZetaChain 代币持有人于周日通过了第 68 号治理提案，以 99.4% 的支持率和 58% 的参与率批准逐步关停其基于 Cosmos 的 layer 1，并按 1:1 兑换将原生 ZETA 迁移为 Solana 上的 SPL 代币，保留相同代币代码和总供应量。根据提案，该投票不会立即触发 ZetaChain 的关停或迁移；核心贡献者将提交第二份提案，详述与其他区块链相关资产的提款窗口、快照区块高度、关停时间表、代币申领流程和交易所转换期，验证者将继续运行，质押奖励在过渡期间继续发放。

events.current_state_en:
A newly launched exchange-traded fund now offers investors regulated exposure to TRON (TRX), the native asset of the TRON blockchain, through an ordinary brokerage account rather than a crypto exchange. The product extends the altcoin ETF wave beyond Bitcoin and Ethereum to a top-20 digital asset.

It marks a market-structure shift: TRX becomes reachable to investors who cannot or will not open a crypto exchange account, potentially widening the holder base and deepening institutional familiarity with the asset. It also strengthens the precedent that altcoins beyond BTC and ETH can obtain US-listed, regulated wrappers, which matters for the dozens of other pending crypto ETF filings.

TRON is a delegated proof-of-stake, smart-contract-capable blockchain whose TRX token can be frozen to obtain Tron Power, giving holders governance weight and energy or bandwidth resources. The asset has also drawn heavy regulatory and law-enforcement scrutiny, with The Wall Street Journal reporting in 2025 that TRON was the channel for more than half of illegal crypto activity in 2024 and the UN Office on Drugs and Crime describing it as a preferred choice for money launderers in Asia.
events.current_state_zh:
一只新推出的交易所交易基金（ETF）现可通过普通券商账户，为投资者提供对 TRON 区块链原生资产 TRX 的受监管敞口，而无需使用加密货币交易所。该产品把山寨币 ETF 的浪潮从比特币和以太坊扩展到了一只市值排名前二十的数字资产。

这标志着市场结构的转变：TRX 现在可以被那些无法或不愿开设加密货币交易所账户的投资者所接触，有望扩大持有者基础并加深机构对该资产的熟悉度。这也强化了“除 BTC 和 ETH 之外的山寨币同样能获得美国上市受监管包装”的先例，对数十份仍在排队中的加密 ETF 申请意义重大。

TRON 是一条采用委托权益证明（DPoS）机制、支持智能合约的区块链，其 TRX 代币可被冻结以获取 Tron Power，从而使持有者获得治理权重以及能量或带宽资源。该资产同时也面临严厉的监管与执法审视：据《华尔街日报》2025 年报道，2024 年超过一半的非法加密活动通过 TRON 进行，联合国毒品和犯罪问题办公室也将其称为亚洲洗钱者的首选渠道之一。
events.title_en: New ETF Gives Regulated TRON Exposure to Traditional Brokerage Investors
events.title_zh: 全新 ETF 为传统券商投资者提供受监管的 TRON 敞口

updates.background_en: An exchange-traded fund is a listed vehicle whose shares trade on a stock exchange and are created or redeemed by authorized participants, letting investors gain exposure to an underlying asset without holding it directly. Crypto ETFs became a mainstream US product after spot Bitcoin and Ethereum funds were approved, and issuers have since pushed a large backlog of applications covering altcoins such as TRX. TRON itself launched in 2017 under the TRON Foundation in Singapore, founded by Justin Sun, and migrated from an Ethereum-based ERC-20 token to its own blockchain in 2018.
updates.background_zh: 交易所交易基金（ETF）是一种上市工具，其份额在证券交易所交易，并由授权参与者进行申购与赎回，使投资者无需直接持有标的资产即可获得敞口。在现货比特币和以太坊基金获批后，加密 ETF 成为美国的主流产品，发行方此后提交了大量覆盖 TRX 等山寨币的申请。TRON 本身于 2017 年由 Justin Sun 创立、在新加坡 TRON 基金会管理下推出，并在 2018 年从基于以太坊的 ERC-20 代币迁移到自有区块链。

updates.market_impact_zh: 传导渠道在于准入与流动性：美国上市的包装工具让券商渠道的资金可通过授权参与者的申购赎回机制触达 TRX，可能影响现货深度以及场内与离岸 TRX 定价之间的价差。这同时也会影响整个山寨币板块的情绪，因为每一次成功上市都会降低市场对其他待批加密 ETF 申请所面临的监管门槛预期。

events.current_state_en: A multinational advisory from Japan, Germany, Australia and the US attributes a North Korean fake-recruiter malware campaign to hacking group WaterPlum, which infected at least 30,000 devices in over 100 countries and stole at least $10.7 million in crypto from developers and Web3 workers.
events.current_state_zh:
朝鲜黑客假扮招聘人员散布恶意软件，全球约3万台设备被感染。这是一场由国家支持、针对科技与加密货币行业求职者的攻击行动。

此次行动表明，假招聘接触仍是与朝鲜有关联的攻击者获取初始访问权限的活跃途径，而这类行动此前已多次针对加密货币和科技领域的开发者。

updates.background_en: DPRK-linked groups tracked as Lazarus Group, APT38 and TraderTraitor have been publicly attributed by the FBI to cryptocurrency theft. Chainalysis reported that crypto theft reached $3.4 billion in 2025, with DPRK activity persisting as a major driver. Separate campaigns such as WaterPlum (also called Contagious Interview) and Graphalgo have used fake recruiter conversations and coding tests to reach developers.

events.current_state_en: Cardano DReps let Input Output's 12.29 million ADA treasury request for Pogun expire without ratification; Koios recorded 64.33% of delegated representative voting power against and 35.67% in favor, while the Constitutional Committee recorded seven yes votes (100% committee approval). In a Sept. 18, 2026 broadcast, Charles Hoskinson said Input Output will choose the best network for each product rather than automatically prioritizing Cardano, while saying Pogun is still headed to Cardano; the proposal had offered 20% of earnings until repayment, then a perpetual 5% on Cardano-related products, with repayment tied to $2.95 million, and stated dates remain forward-looking targets.
events.current_state_zh: Cardano的DRep代表让Input Output为Pogun提出的1229万ADA国库请求到期而未获批准；Koios摘要显示DRep投票权64.33%反对、35.67%赞成，宪法委员会则记录七票赞成（100%委员会批准）。Charles Hoskinson在2026年9月18日广播中称Input Output将按技术和商业契合度选择网络、不再自动优先Cardano，但称Pogun仍将登陆Cardano；该提案曾提议返还20%收益直至偿付、之后对Cardano相关产品永久返还5%，正式提案将偿付与295万美元挂钩，相关日期仍属前瞻性目标。

events.current_state_en: On Sept. 6, Liquid lost almost 4,000 Bitcoin through a withdrawal its software approved even though the private keys used to authorize it had not been stolen; according to TRM Labs' reconstruction, attackers exploited a software flaw to create L-BTC without backing Bitcoin and exchanged those tokens for real coins. Crypto insurance can cover losses without guaranteeing customers full reimbursement, and even successful repayment can leave customers short if compensation is calculated in dollars instead of Bitcoin.
events.current_state_zh: 9月6日，Liquid 因软件批准了一笔本不应合格的提款而流失近 4,000 枚比特币，尽管授权该提款的私钥并未被盗；据 TRM Labs 还原，攻击者利用软件缺陷创建了没有比特币背书的 L-BTC，并将其兑换成真实比特币。加密货币保险可能承保损失，但不保证客户获得全额赔偿，且若以美元而非比特币计算赔付，即使成功还款也可能让客户仍遭受短缺。

events.current_state_en: Solana’s 250ms slot time became effective at epoch 1037 on Sept. 18, according to the Solana engineering changelog and a Solana Compass report that placed the transition at about 05:06 UTC; an early Sept. 20 sample covering 60 one-minute windows observed about 266ms per produced slot, and epoch 1037 skipped about 0.05% of scheduled slots. The source says the more important test is whether leader handoffs, transaction forwarding, repair and multiple validator clients remain reliable as Solana considers a conditional move to 200ms.
events.current_state_zh: Solana 的 250ms slot time 已在 9 月 18 日 epoch 1037 生效；根据 Solana 工程 changelog 和 Solana Compass 报告，过渡时间约为 05:06 UTC。9 月 20 日一份覆盖 60 个一分钟窗口的早期样本观察到每个已产出 slot 约 266ms，epoch 1037 约跳过 0.05% 的计划 slot；报道称更重要的考验是 Solana 考虑有条件转向 200ms 时，leader 交接、交易转发、修复和多种验证者客户端能否保持可靠。

events.current_state_en: According to Crypto In America, JP Morgan has scored a narrower victory in a separate fight over credit card rewards on crypto purchases; according to a source familiar with the matter, Visa is moving to close an apparent loophole in Crossmint-powered checkouts that allowed meme coin purchases made with credit cards to be processed under a merchant code intended for digital media. Earlier, Chase told The Block that one Visa transaction was misclassified and should not have earned rewards, and the New York attorney general's office also told The Block it was aware of and reviewing the matter; meme coin purchases will continue but must be processed as crypto transactions under Visa's rules, and processors have a grace period expected to end next week.
events.current_state_zh: 据 Crypto In America 获悉，JP Morgan 在一场围绕加密货币购买信用卡奖励的单独争议中取得较小胜利；据一位知情人士称，Visa 正着手关闭 Crossmint 支持的结账流程中的一个疑似漏洞，该漏洞允许信用卡购买的 meme 币按面向数字媒体的商户代码处理。此前 Chase 告诉 The Block，一笔 Visa 交易被错误分类、不应获得奖励，纽约州总检察长办公室也告诉 The Block 其知悉并正在审查此事；meme 币购买仍将继续，但必须按加密交易处理并受 Visa 规则约束，支付处理商有一个预计下周结束的宽限期。
events.title_en: Visa Moves to Close Meme Coin Credit Card Rewards Loophole
events.title_zh: Visa 着手关闭 Meme 币信用卡奖励漏洞
