events.current_state_en: The Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, a zero-knowledge proof payment layer that lets metered API providers verify payment via onchain vault deposits and short-lived spending-capped keys without learning payer identity, initially targeting AI inference.
events.current_state_zh: The Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, a zero-knowledge proof payment layer that lets metered API providers verify payment via onchain vault deposits and short-lived spending-capped keys without learning payer identity, initially targeting AI inference.
events.title_en: Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Launch zkAPI for Privacy-Preserving API P
events.title_zh: Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Launch zkAPI for Privacy-Preserving API P

updates.background_en: The launch follows earlier Ethereum developer discussion of a privacy model for AI chatbots that shields user identities while still letting providers verify payments, as reported by crypto-economy.com. Vault-based onchain deposit structures are an established pattern on Ethereum mainnet.
updates.background_zh: 据 crypto-economy.com 报道，此次发布之前，以太坊开发者已就一种面向 AI 聊天机器人的隐私模型展开讨论，该模型在保护用户身份的同时仍允许服务提供方验证付款。基于金库的链上存款结构在以太坊主网上已是较为成熟的模式。
updates.current_state_en: The Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, a zero-knowledge proof payment layer that lets metered API providers verify payment via onchain vault deposits and short-lived spending-capped keys without learning payer identity, initially targeting AI inference.
updates.current_state_zh:
以太坊基金会与 Open Anonymity Project 推出 zkAPI，这是一个面向计量式 API 的隐私保护支付层，现已在以太坊主网上线。用户将 ETH、USDC 或其他额度存入链上金库（vault），并通过零知识证明授权支出，使服务提供方能够验证付款，而无需得知付款人身份或该笔用量由哪笔存款支付。

据 Coinotag 报道，此次上线为以太坊隐私技术栈提供了一个在主网运行的零知识支付范例，也让以太坊基金会拥有可供其他团队参考的部署案例；而 AI 推理这一侧仍需使用数据才能称得上被采用。

zkAPI 可签发短期有效、带支出上限的 API 密钥，并按实际用量结算，初期聚焦 AI 推理，也可扩展到其他按使用量付费的服务。该系统不提供网络层或内容层匿名性，意味着 IP 地址、时间模式和提示词中的身份信息仍可能被关联。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, a zero-knowledge proof payment layer that lets metered API providers verify payment via onchain vault deposits and short-lived spending-capped keys without learning payer identity, initially targeting AI inference.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The Ethereum Foundation and Open Anonymity Project launched zkAPI on Ethereum mainnet, a zero-knowledge proof payment layer that lets metered API providers verify payment via onchain vault deposits and short-lived spending-capped keys without learning payer identity, initially targeting AI inference.
updates.market_impact_en: The primitive routes pay-per-use settlement through onchain vault deposits denominated in ETH and USDC, creating a new demand channel for vault contracts and privacy tooling on Ethereum mainnet; the extent of that effect depends on provider adoption and usage, which the available evidence does not yet establish.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该基础设施将以太坊主网上以 ETH 和 USDC 计价的链上金库存款作为按使用量付费的结算通道，为金库合约和隐私工具带来新的需求来源；其影响程度取决于服务提供方的采用情况与实际用量，而现有信息尚不足以确认这一点。

events.current_state_en: OpenAI says it disrupted a large-scale effort to extract its models' hidden reasoning traces, tracing a core cluster of the activity to people associated with China's Moonshot AI, maker of the Kimi chatbot.
events.current_state_zh: OpenAI says it disrupted a large-scale effort to extract its models' hidden reasoning traces, tracing a core cluster of the activity to people associated with China's Moonshot AI, maker of the Kimi chatbot.
events.title_en: OpenAI Says People Linked to China's Moonshot Tried to Copy Its AI's Hidden Reasoning
events.title_zh: OpenAI Says People Linked to China's Moonshot Tried to Copy Its AI's Hidden Reasoning

updates.background_en: OpenAI has made similar accusations before: in January 2025 it said it was reviewing signs that DeepSeek may have distilled its models, as Washington weighed national security risks. Anthropic followed in February, accusing Chinese labs of using about 24,000 fraudulent accounts to generate more than 16 million exchanges with Claude; by April the White House was describing industrial-scale distillation campaigns by foreign entities, primarily in China, and in June Anthropic asked Congress for penalties on large-scale model extraction. In August, researchers showed that OpenAI, Anthropic and Google each protected reasoning with a single provider-wide encryption key, and that attackers could coax models into outputting the hidden thoughts in plain text; all three deployed server-side patches after disclosure.
updates.background_zh: OpenAI此前有过类似指控：2025年1月，它表示正在审查DeepSeek可能蒸馏其模型的迹象，当时华盛顿正在评估国家安全风险。Anthropic随后在2月指控中国实验室使用约2.4万个欺诈账户与Claude进行了逾1600万次交互；到4月，白宫称外国实体——主要在中国——正在进行工业规模的蒸馏活动；6月，Anthropic呼吁国会对大规模模型提取行为施加处罚。8月，研究人员披露OpenAI、Anthropic和谷歌各自仅用一个覆盖全平台的加密密钥保护推理内容，攻击者可诱导模型以明文输出这些隐藏思路；三家公司在披露后均部署了服务端修复。
updates.current_state_en: OpenAI says it disrupted a large-scale effort to extract its models' hidden reasoning traces, tracing a core cluster of the activity to people associated with China's Moonshot AI, maker of the Kimi chatbot.
updates.current_state_zh:
OpenAI表示，它已阻止了一场有组织地提取其模型在作答前所生成隐藏推理的活动，并称该活动始于7月1日。仅在7月24日和25日两天，OpenAI就记录到来自4000多名用户的1.6万次提取请求，而整个用户群超过1.5万人；OpenAI称该活动已于7月28日被完全阻断。

OpenAI称，这些被提取的隐藏推理可能被用来训练另一个模型，从而绕过原有的安全防护。OpenAI表示，此后已关闭一条路径——该路径曾允许已持有他人加密推理内容的人通过重放来还原其内容。

OpenAI称，相关操作者“没有破解我们的加密、入侵数据库，也没有直接访问已存储的用户对话”，而是通过操纵模型交互，使受保护的推理能够以可见形式被复制，违反了其服务条款；其中一种方法是把一段对话中的加密推理复制出来，再让模型在另一段对话中解码。OpenAI还表示，尚不清楚所观察到的所有操作者是否来自同一行为体，但将这一活动的“核心集群”归因于与Kimi开发者月之暗面有关联的个人。
updates.detailed_summary_en: OpenAI says it disrupted a large-scale effort to extract its models' hidden reasoning traces, tracing a core cluster of the activity to people associated with China's Moonshot AI, maker of the Kimi chatbot.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: OpenAI says it disrupted a large-scale effort to extract its models' hidden reasoning traces, tracing a core cluster of the activity to people associated with China's Moonshot AI, maker of the Kimi chatbot.
updates.market_impact_en: The disclosure does not directly involve crypto assets; any transmission runs through sentiment, as renewed attention to model-output provenance and cross-border AI IP disputes can affect the AI-narrative segment of crypto markets, including AI-themed tokens and decentralized inference or compute networks. The channel is narrative and regulatory attention rather than cash flows or custody, and the report itself contains no market data.
updates.market_impact_zh: 该披露并不直接涉及加密资产；其传导主要通过情绪面——围绕模型输出溯源和跨境AI知识产权争端的关注度上升，可能影响加密市场中的AI叙事板块，包括AI概念代币以及去中心化推理/算力网络。其传导渠道是叙事与监管关注，而非资金流或托管，且该报道本身不含任何市场数据。

events.current_state_en: The IMF approved a $138 million disbursement to El Salvador under its $1.4 billion Extended Fund Facility and granted a waiver for the breach of program conditions limiting further bitcoin purchases; El Salvador committed to stop accumulating BTC beyond recorded donations and reduce government involvement in Bitcoin-related activities.
events.current_state_zh: IMF批准向萨尔瓦多拨付1.38亿美元资金，作为其14亿美元扩展基金安排（EFF）计划的一部分，并批准了此前未满足比特币积累限制相关项目要求的豁免。萨尔瓦多承诺不再进行超出已记录捐赠范围的比特币积累，并继续降低政府在比特币相关活动中的参与度。

events.current_state_en: The US Treasury has sanctioned Russia-linked shadow banking network A7 Network and its A7A5 token, designating A7 as a significant transnational criminal organization; FinCEN proposed barring covered financial institutions from transfers involving A7 sub-agents/front companies, including convertible virtual currency, and estimated more than 180 entities processed at least $179.1 billion in A7A5.

updates.current_state_en: The US Treasury has sanctioned Russia-linked shadow banking network A7 Network and its ruble-backed A7A5 token, designating A7 as a significant transnational criminal organization; FinCEN proposed barring covered financial institutions from transfers involving A7 sub-agents and issued a risk advisory. The network allegedly moved over $17 billion via A7A5, USDT and intermediaries.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国财政部已对俄罗斯关联影子银行网络A7 Network及其卢布支持的A7A5代币实施制裁，并将其指定为重大跨国犯罪组织；FinCEN提议禁止受管辖金融机构处理涉及A7子代理的转移，同时发布风险指引。网络据称通过A7A5、USDT和中介转移超过170亿美元。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The US Treasury sanctioned the Russia-linked A7 payment network and FinCEN proposed new restrictions barring covered financial institutions from handling transfers involving its sub-agents, targeting a system that allegedly moved over $17 billion via A7A5, USDT and intermediaries.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The US Treasury sanctioned the Russia-linked A7 payment network and FinCEN proposed new restrictions barring covered financial institutions from handling transfers involving its sub-agents, targeting a system that allegedly moved over $17 billion via A7A5, USDT and intermediaries.
updates.title_en: US targets $17 billion Russia-linked crypto payment network using USDT as an escape route
updates.title_zh: 美国盯上涉资170亿美元、以USDT作为逃生通道的俄罗斯关联加密支付网络
updates.what_changed_en: The US Treasury designated A7 Network as a significant transnational criminal organization, expanding blocking sanctions from individual companies to the broader payment network, while FinCEN proposed barring covered financial institutions from transmitting funds involving identified A7 sub-agents.
updates.what_changed_zh: 美国财政部将A7网络指定为重大跨国犯罪组织，将制裁范围从个别公司扩大到整个支付网络；FinCEN同时提议禁止受管辖金融机构处理涉及已识别A7子代理的资金转移。

updates.current_state_en: The US Treasury has sanctioned Russia-linked shadow banking network A7 Network and its A7A5 token, designating A7 as a significant transnational criminal organization; FinCEN proposed barring covered financial institutions from transfers involving A7 sub-agents/front companies, including convertible virtual currency, and estimated more than 180 entities processed at least $179.1 billion in A7A5.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国财政部已制裁俄罗斯关联影子银行网络A7 Network及其A7A5代币，并将其指定为重大跨国犯罪组织；FinCEN提议禁止受管辖金融机构处理涉及A7子代理/前线公司的转移，包括可转换虚拟货币，并估算超180个实体通过A7A5处理了至少1791亿美元。
updates.detailed_summary_en: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC designated Russia's A7 Network a transnational criminal organization and FinCEN proposed barring American financial institutions from any transfers — including convertible virtual currency — involving its front companies, which it says processed over $179 billion in the ruble-backed A7A5 token.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: The U.S. Treasury's OFAC designated Russia's A7 Network a transnational criminal organization and FinCEN proposed barring American financial institutions from any transfers — including convertible virtual currency — involving its front companies, which it says processed over $179 billion in the ruble-backed A7A5 token.
updates.title_en: US Designates Russia's A7 Network as Transnational Criminal Organization
updates.title_zh: 美国将俄罗斯的 A7 Network 列为跨国犯罪组织
updates.what_changed_en: Decrypt added FinCEN detail estimating that more than 180 entities processed at least $179.1 billion in A7A5 between February 2025 and June 2026; the proposed rule covers convertible virtual currency and uses the sixth special measure under Section 9714 of the Combating Russian Money Laundering Act, binding roughly 348,000 institutions.
updates.what_changed_zh: Decrypt报道补充了FinCEN的详细估算：超过180个实体在2025年2月至2026年6月间通过A7A5处理了至少1791亿美元；拟议规则覆盖可转换虚拟货币，并依据《打击俄罗斯洗钱法》第9714条第六项特别措施，约束约34.8万家机构。

events.current_state_en: Tether-backed Utexo has obtained a commercial license to issue USDT on Bitcoin and plans to launch native USDT this month using the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model, supporting private transfers, native BTC-USDT swaps and BTC-collateralized lending, with Lightning Network expansion to follow.
events.current_state_zh: Tether 支持的 Utexo 已获得在比特币网络发行 USDT 的商业许可，计划本月基于 RGB 协议和比特币 UTXO 模型发行原生 USDT，支持隐私转账、原生 BTC-USDT 兑换和 BTC 抵押借贷，之后扩展至 Lightning Network。
events.title_en: Tether's USDT is 'coming home' to Bitcoin this month over a decade after debut there
events.title_zh: Tether的USDT本月“回家”重返比特币，距其首次在该网络亮相已过去十多年

updates.current_state_en: Tether-backed project Utexo plans to bring native USDT to Bitcoin this month, enabling private transfers, direct BTC-to-USDT swaps and bitcoin-backed loans with data kept off the public ledger, followed by Lightning Network support.
updates.current_state_zh: Tether支持的项目Utexo计划本月将原生USDT引入比特币，支持隐私转账、BTC与USDT直接兑换以及比特币抵押贷款，且数据不保留在公共账本上，随后还将支持闪电网络。

updates.current_state_en: Tether-backed Utexo has obtained a commercial license to issue USDT on Bitcoin and plans to launch native USDT this month using the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model, supporting private transfers, native BTC-USDT swaps and BTC-collateralized lending, with Lightning Network expansion to follow.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Tether-backed Utexo says it has obtained a commercial license and plans to issue USDT on the Bitcoin network this month using the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model, enabling private USDT transfers, native BTC-USDT swaps and BTC-collateralized lending before expanding to Lightning.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Tether-backed Utexo says it has obtained a commercial license and plans to issue USDT on the Bitcoin network this month using the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model, enabling private USDT transfers, native BTC-USDT swaps and BTC-collateralized lending before expanding to Lightning.
updates.title_en: Tether支持的Utexo计划本月在比特币网络发行USDT
updates.title_zh: Tether支持的Utexo计划本月在比特币网络发行USDT
updates.what_changed_en: Utexo co-founder Viktor Ihnatiuk said the company has obtained a commercial license to issue USDT on Bitcoin, and disclosed it will use the RGB protocol and Bitcoin's UTXO model with most transaction data kept off-chain, offering APIs, SDKs and cloud infrastructure to exchanges, wallets and payment providers.
updates.what_changed_zh: Utexo 联合创始人 Viktor Ihnatiuk 表示公司已获得在比特币上发行 USDT 的商业许可，并披露将基于 RGB 协议与比特币 UTXO 模型实现，大部分交易数据保留在链下，并为交易所、钱包及支付服务商提供 API、SDK 和云端基础设施。

events.current_state_en: Blast is ceasing operations because maintenance costs exceed revenue; users need to withdraw assets to Ethereum mainnet via the standard interface by Oct. 26; withdrawal wait time is planned to be shortened to 24 hours, but withdrawals are temporarily unavailable for about a week while Blast exits its Lido holdings, and after the deadline assets can still be withdrawn via the Blast Bridge contract on Ethereum L1.
events.current_state_zh: Blast 因维护成本超过收入而停止运营，用户需在 10 月 26 日前通过常规界面将资产撤回以太坊主网；提现等待时间计划缩短至 24 小时，但团队先退出其 Lido 资产，预计约一周内提现功能暂时不可用，截止后仍可通过以太坊 L1 上的 Blast Bridge 合约提取。
events.title_en: Bithumb将BLAST列入交易注意名单，因Blast宣布主网运营结束计划

updates.current_state_en: Blast announced it is shutting down its L2 because maintenance costs exceed revenue, telling users to withdraw assets to Ethereum mainnet via the normal interface before October 26, 2026; subsequently, Upbit and Bithumb added BLAST to trading-caution watchlists and suspended deposits, and BLAST fell over 27%.

metadata.background: Liquid Network is a Bitcoin sidechain: a separate blockchain that runs alongside Bitcoin, allowing exchanges to settle transactions more quickly and privately than on the main blockchain. Users lock bitcoin on the main chain and receive a corresponding balance on Liquid for faster settlement. Because it is an additional layer, a vulnerability in its code can put funds at risk even though Bitcoin's main blockchain itself is not directly compromised.
metadata.background_en: Liquid Network is a Bitcoin sidechain: a separate blockchain that runs alongside Bitcoin, allowing exchanges to settle transactions more quickly and privately than on the main blockchain. Users lock bitcoin on the main chain and receive a corresponding balance on Liquid for faster settlement. Because it is an additional layer, a vulnerability in its code can put funds at risk even though Bitcoin's main blockchain itself is not directly compromised.
metadata.background_zh: Liquid Network是一条比特币侧链：它是一条与比特币并行运行的独立区块链，使交易所能够比在主链上更快、更保密地完成结算。用户将比特币锁定在主链上，并在Liquid上获得对应的余额用于快速结算。由于它是额外的层，其代码中的漏洞可能会使资金面临风险，即使比特币主链本身并未被直接攻击。
metadata.detailed_summary:
The Liquid Network, a blockchain settlement layer used by several cryptocurrency exchanges to move Bitcoin, was hacked for $320 million. The network halted all transactions after the exploit, which was reported around September 7, 2026.

This is one of the latest major breaches to shake confidence in digital-asset security, and it exposes risks in the settlement infrastructure exchanges depend on. The incident may lead to stricter scrutiny of sidechain security and affect trust in exchange-related Bitcoin custody and transfer methods.

Liquid Network is a Bitcoin sidechain designed to allow faster and more confidential transfers between exchanges. CoinDesk reported that the hacker made a conditional offer, with the attackers claiming they were 'the good guys.'
metadata.detailed_summary_en:

This is one of the latest major breaches to shake confidence in digital-asset security, and it exposes risks in the settlement infrastructure exchanges depend on. The incident may lead to stricter scrutiny of sidechain security and affect trust in exchange-related Bitcoin custody and transfer methods.

Liquid Network is a Bitcoin sidechain designed to allow faster and more confidential transfers between exchanges. CoinDesk reported that the hacker made a conditional offer, with the attackers claiming they were 'the good guys.'
metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
多个加密货币交易所用于转移比特币的结算层Liquid Network遭到黑客攻击，被盗3.2亿美元。据报道，该网络在2026年9月7日前后遭到攻击后已暂停所有交易。

这是近期一系列重大安全事件中最新的一起，动摇了人们对数字资产安全的信心，也暴露出交易所依赖的结算基础设施所面临的风险。该事件可能促使业界更严格地审视侧链安全，并影响人们对交易所相关比特币托管和转账方式的信任。

Liquid Network是一条比特币侧链，旨在让交易所之间进行更快、更保密的转账。CoinDesk报道称，黑客提出了附带条件的提议，并自称“好人”。
metadata.market_impact_en: Because Liquid Network is a settlement layer used by exchanges to move Bitcoin, the exploit may disrupt exchange settlement and custody flows that rely on it, and it could dampen sentiment toward Bitcoin sidechains. The transmission channel is operational and reputational risk to crypto infrastructure rather than a direct attack on the Bitcoin mainnet.

item.ai_reason: Balancer is a foundational DeFi protocol whose v2 code has been forked across 27 protocols, and a $130M hack followed by a governance proposal to sunset the protocol and distribute its $9M treasury represents a material, structural event for DeFi market structure and a major protocol failure with demonstrated ecosystem-wide impact.
item.ai_summary: Balancer Labs CEO Marcus Hardt has proposed a phased sunset of the protocol after a $130M hack and failed efforts to restore profitability, with the remaining $9M treasury to be distributed pro-rata to BAL holders.
item.author: Jake Harrison
item.content:
DeFi stalwart Balancer mulls shutdown after $130M hack
Once a household name in the DeFi sector, decentralized exchange Balancer is considering calling it quits.
In a proposal posted to the project’s governance forum, Balancer Labs CEO Marcus Hardt suggests a “phased sunset of the protocol.”
The post explains that none of the efforts to return to profitability, employed in response to last year’s hack, “converted into sustained revenue growth.”
Under Hardt’s proposal, Balancer’s $9 million treasury would be distributed to BAL holders, pro-rata.
Read more: Balancer exploit drains $129M in DeFi disaster
The problem
Launched just in time for 2020’s “DeFi summer,” Balancer innovated on the existing two-asset automated market maker model used by Uniswap and Bancor to introduce multi-asset pools and custom pool weighting.
It was a successful project in itself and was widely ‘forked,’ its popular v2 code has been used in 27 protocols across multiple blockchains, according to DeFiLlama data. Balancer’s total value-locked (TVL) peaked in November 2021 at over $3 billion, and now stands at just $58 million.
Then on its third iteration, Balancer’s v3 protocol was hit by a devastating exploit in November last year, with losses totalling almost $130 million and causing a ripple effect across the sector.
Both before and since, the project experienced a handful of smaller security incidents. The latest came just last month, when its original v1 codebase was exploited for over $200,000.
Read more: Osmosis took 74 days to discover 40-BTC Nomic exploit
Previously, in September 2023, Balancer lost approximately $1.2 million from “Boosted Pools” across its Ethereum and Optimism deployments. DeFiLlama’s database includes incidents from 2023 and 2020, totalling a further $1.3 million in losses.
The proposal
Hardt proposes an “orderly wind down,” which would include stripping back the DAO as much as possible and distributing treasury funds to BAL holders.
The wind down would see all pools moved to withdrawal-only mode on October 30, and the fate of DAO-owned assets beyond the treasury would be subject to a further vote.
The proposal brings forward a pending review of the recovery plan’s success, as Hardt feels that “waiting for the calendar would change the numbers, not the conclusion, and every month of waiting is spent from the treasury.”
He further detailed his reasoning in a post on X. The cost-reduction side of the recovery plan was a success, he claims, but protocol revenue failed to grow.
He “underestimated how much the exploit would continue to limit adoption,” which led to smaller sums deployed and hesitation from counterparties.
He also paid tribute to the Balancer team who kept v3 “safe,” “usable” and “alive,” during the “hardest year the protocol has had,” all as “smaller team and with less money.”
Shutdown season
Balancer’s decision comes as many other well-known DeFi projects opt to close down, or take a substantial pivot.
Last week, Harmony announced it would shut down its blockchain in response to “threats posed by state actors and AI agents.” It will move operations to Ethereum and plans a pivot to become “the remix economy for AI video.”
Popular DEX aggregator Odos Protocol shut down in July and beleaguered “real-world asset” lending platform Goldfinch threw in the towel the month prior.
Outside of DeFi, centralized exchange AscendEx announced its cessation of operations in early July, amidst concerns over liquidity to process pending user withdrawals.
Just hours ago, CoinEx gave its users a three-month deadline to withdraw assets, warning it would charge a 5% monthly custody fee from December 22.

item.ai_summary: Grayscale's Zcash ETF (ZCSH) is planning a 3-for-1 share split after a $233 million inflow surge pushed assets to nearly $890 million amid ZEC's rally and record mining competition.
item.author: Kyle Baird
item.content: The Grayscale Zcash ETF (ZCSH) nears $890 million in assets as ZEC’s rally pushes mining competition to record highs.

metadata.background: Zcash (ZEC) is a privacy-focused cryptocurrency that uses zero-knowledge proofs, known as zk-SNARKs, to allow shielded transactions in which sender, recipient and amount can be hidden. Grayscale, the largest digital asset manager, converted its long-running Zcash Trust into an exchange-traded fund under the ticker ZCSH, giving brokerage-account investors direct price exposure to ZEC. Share splits are a common administrative step for funds and stocks whose unit price has risen sharply, since a lower nominal price can improve accessibility and trading granularity. Zcash, like Bitcoin, is secured by proof-of-work mining, and the recent price rally has made its mining economics unusually attractive relative to Bitcoin.

Grayscale, the largest digital asset manager, converted its long-running Zcash Trust into an exchange-traded fund under the ticker ZCSH, giving brokerage-account investors direct price exposure to ZEC. Share splits are a common administrative step for funds and stocks whose unit price has risen sharply, since a lower nominal price can improve accessibility and trading granularity. Zcash, like Bitcoin, is secured by proof-of-work mining, and the recent price rally has made its mining economics unusually attractive relative to Bitcoin.
metadata.background_zh: Zcash（ZEC）是一种以隐私为核心的加密货币，使用名为 zk-SNARKs 的零知识证明来支持“屏蔽交易”，可以隐藏发送方、接收方和金额。管理规模最大的数字资产管理公司 Grayscale 将其长期运营的 Zcash Trust 转换为交易所交易基金，代码为 ZCSH，使券商账户投资者可以直接获得 ZEC 的价格敞口。对于单位价格大幅上涨的基金和股票而言，份额拆分是一种常见的行政操作，因为更低的名义价格有助于改善可及性和交易粒度。与比特币类似，Zcash 依靠工作量证明挖矿来维护网络安全，近期价格上涨使其挖矿经济性相对于比特币显得格外有吸引力。
metadata.detailed_summary:
Grayscale's Zcash ETF (ZCSH) is planning a 3-for-1 share split after a $233 million inflow surge pushed the fund's assets to nearly $890 million. The move follows a sharp rally in ZEC that has also driven mining competition on the Zcash network to record highs.

A share split lowers the per-share price of ZCSH, making the ETF easier to buy in smaller amounts and potentially broadening its retail investor base. It also signals that institutional-style, exchange-traded exposure to a privacy-focused asset has grown large enough to warrant routine market-structure housekeeping, a notable step for a category long treated as niche by regulated venues.

A 3-for-1 split triples the number of shares outstanding while dividing the price per share by three, leaving the fund's total assets and each holder's overall value unchanged. ZCSH is structured as an exchange-traded product that is not registered under the Investment Company Act of 1940, so it does not carry the same regulatory protections as 1940 Act-registered ETFs and mutual funds.

Grayscale 旗下的 Zcash ETF（代码 ZCSH）计划实施 1 拆 3 的份额拆分，此前该基金在资金流入激增 2.33 亿美元后，资产规模已接近 8.9 亿美元。此举发生在 ZEC 价格大幅上涨、并把 Zcash 网络的挖矿竞争推向历史高位之后。

份额拆分将降低 ZCSH 的每份价格，使投资者能以更小金额买入，从而有可能扩大其散户投资者基础。这也表明，面向隐私类资产的机构化交易所交易敞口已成长到需要进行常规市场结构维护的规模，对一个长期被受监管场所视为小众的资产类别而言是值得关注的一步。

1 拆 3 的拆分会使流通份额数量增加两倍、每份价格降至原来的三分之一，基金总资产和每位持有人的整体价值不变。ZCSH 属于交易所交易产品，并未根据 1940 年《投资公司法》注册，因此不享有与 1940 法案注册的 ETF 和共同基金同等的监管保护。
metadata.market_impact_en: The transmission runs mainly through ETF share creation and redemption: Grayscale's authorized participants must source ZEC to meet ZCSH demand, linking fund flows to spot market liquidity for the token. A split alters share count and per-share price rather than the fund's underlying ZEC holdings, so the more consequential market variable is whether inflows continue, while rising hashrate and competition feed back into miner margins and the economics of proof-of-work mining more broadly.
metadata.market_impact_zh: 传导主要通过 ETF 的份额创设与赎回进行：Grayscale 的授权参与者需要买入 ZEC 以满足 ZCSH 的需求，从而把基金资金流与 ZEC 现货市场的流动性联系起来。拆分改变的是份额数量和每份价格，而非基金持有的 ZEC 数量，因此更具实质影响的市场变量是资金流入能否持续；与此同时，算力上升与竞争加剧会反过来影响矿工利润以及更广泛的工作量证明挖矿经济性。

metadata.background: BitMEX, owned and operated by HDR Global Trading Limited, helped define early crypto derivatives trading by popularising the perpetual swap with high leverage, and CoinDesk and Yahoo Finance both frame the shutdown as the end of an 11-year run. Its share of the derivatives market has fallen far below its peak, and the wind-down is presented as a board decision following a strategic review rather than a stated insolvency.

metadata.background_zh: BitMEX 由 HDR Global Trading Limited 所有并运营，凭借高杠杆的永续掉期（永续合约）塑造了早期加密衍生品交易格局；CoinDesk 与 Yahoo Finance 的报道均将其关停描述为 11 年运营的终结。该交易所在衍生品市场的份额已远低于巅峰水平，此次关停被表述为董事会经战略评估后作出的决定，而非已披露的破产或资不抵债事件。
metadata.detailed_summary:
BitMEX announced the closure of its exchange, set to take effect on 23 September 2026 at 04:00 UTC, ending an 11-year run, and said all new account registrations stopped with immediate effect. The board of HDR Global Trading Limited, BitMEX's owner and operator, took the decision after a strategic review of the business and the broader crypto industry, and users are being urged to close positions and withdraw funds.

BitMEX pioneered the 100x-leverage perpetual swap, the contract format that became the standard for crypto derivatives, so its exit pushes remaining derivatives traders to migrate open positions and liquidity to rival perpetual-swap venues.

According to BitMEX's own announcement, the closure takes effect at exactly 04:00:00 UTC on 23 September 2026, and new account registrations were halted with immediate effect rather than at the closure time. The official notice directs users to close positions and withdraw funds before that deadline.

metadata.detailed_summary_zh:
BitMEX 宣布关闭其交易所，生效时间为 2026 年 9 月 23 日 04:00 UTC，从而结束长达 11 年的运营，并已立即停止所有新账户注册。运营方 HDR Global Trading Limited 董事会在对业务及整体加密行业进行战略评估后作出这一决定，平台同时敦促用户尽快平仓并提取资金。

BitMEX 开创了 100 倍杠杆的永续合约，这一合约形式后来成为加密衍生品的主流标准，因此其退出促使剩余的衍生品交易者把未平仓头寸和流动性迁移到其他永续合约交易所。

根据 BitMEX 官方公告，关停于 2026 年 9 月 23 日 04:00:00 UTC 正式生效，而新账户注册是立即停止、而非等到关停时点才停止。官方通知要求用户在该期限前平仓并提取资金。

item.ai_reason: A genuine in-window security disclosure (September 25) from Revoke.cash about a vulnerability in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2 that leaves stale NFT approvals active for former Magic Eden users. A researcher moved 3,832 NFTs via zero-ETH sales, framed as a whitehat rescue, and the assets are held pending return. This is a concrete, actionable contract-level vulnerability affecting live wallets, but it is narrower than a systemic exploit: no confirmed malicious losses and impact is limited to users who haven't revoked approvals, keeping it below the major-incident tier.
item.ai_summary: Revoke.cash warned on September 25 that a flaw in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2 leaves old Magic Eden NFT approvals exploitable on Ethereum and ApeChain, after security researcher 0xQuit moved 3,832 NFTs through zero-ETH sales as a whitehat rescue and placed them in a custody wallet.
item.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
item.content:
Quick Take
- A flaw in an NFT payment processor leaves some former marketplace users with risky approvals.
- A security researcher moved 3,832 NFTs in zero ETH sales and described the transfers as a rescue.
- The warning covers old approvals on Ethereum and ApeChain, while malicious NFT losses remain unclear.
Old Magic Eden NFT approvals could still put some former users at risk months after the company closed its Ethereum marketplace. A September 25 warning from wallet security service Revoke.cash says that a vulnerability in Limit Break's Payment Processor V2 affects wallets that still authorize the contract to move NFTs. Those approvals remain active until owners revoke them.
The notice says security researcher 0xQuit used the vulnerability to move 3,832 NFTs from approved wallets as zero ETH sales. He described the transfers as a whitehat rescue and said the assets were being held in a custody wallet until it was safe to return them, according to Revoke.cash. The figure counts transfers reported in the notice; the service had not established how many NFTs, if any, malicious actors took.
Magic Eden ended EVM marketplace support on March 9, 2026. Its listings and offers were offchain and ceased to be visible or actionable on the site. The operator approval users gave the processor exists onchain, however. Closing the marketplace did not cancel that separate permission, leaving people who have not traded there for months with a live exposure.
Which Magic Eden NFT approvals should users revoke?
Revoke.cash says users should revoke Payment Processor V2 approval on Ethereum. It also warns anyone who approved Payment Processor V3 on ApeChain to revoke that separate permission. An NFT operator approval lets a contract move assets on a wallet's behalf. A permission granted for marketplace trading can outlast the listing that prompted it, so former users need to check the approval itself rather than their old sale history.
Canceling a listing will not protect an exposed wallet, Revoke.cash said. Its FAQ also explains that disconnecting a wallet from a website leaves onchain approvals active. The incident page includes an exploit checker so users can inspect whether their address is affected and revoke the relevant permission. The warning applies to the named processor approvals; it does not establish that losses occurred on both Ethereum and ApeChain. Revocation is a preventive step, the FAQ says: it reduces future exposure but does not retrieve assets already taken. That distinction makes checking old permissions urgent even while the full incident outcome remains unknown.
The technical details of the flaw had not been published in Revoke.cash's September 25 notice, and the service said it remained unclear whether malicious actors had taken any NFTs. The reported rescue leaves the final loss figure unresolved. For holders with lingering approvals, the action identified in the warning is to revoke access to the affected processor contracts.
